name: Dill Mill Gayye
description: Dill Mill Gayye is an Indian soap medical drama TV series that aired on STAR One. It was the sequel of the television series Sanjivani, which aired on STAR Plus channel. The show ended in October 2010 after running for 3 years. The show was successful amongst the youth of the country that even after so years following its conclusion, the actors of the show like Karan Singh Grover, Shilpa Anand, Jennifer Winget, Sukirti Kandpal, Drashti Dhami, Shweta Gulati and Karan Wahi are still fondly remembered by the people.

videos.title: Dr. Riddhima Defeats Dr. Armaan
videos.overview: Follows the lives of surgical interns and resident doctors of Sanjeevani. Set in the backdrop of Sanjeevani Hospital, it deals with the pressures, drama, romance, inter personal relationships and humour in their lives.

videos.title: Tiff Between Armaan and Riddhima
videos.overview: After Riddhima runs some clotting tests on a patient, she gets in to an argument with Armaan. However, Kirti intervenes and later confirms Riddhima's diagnosis and treatment. Already miffed, Armaan then warns Riddhima to be careful. Why is Armaan so annoyed?

videos.title: Riddhima Wins Her Patients' Hearts
videos.overview: After Armaan and Riddhima argue over their bet, Riddhima overhears Armaan scolding a girl and then she attends to a pregnant women. The same patient asks Kirti to replace Anjali with Riddhima for her surgery. Will Riddhima succeed in operating on the pregnant woman?

videos.title: Sapna Falls In Love With Dr Rai
videos.overview: Sapna meets and falls in love with Shubhankar Rai, a cardiologist. Rai is treating Sunaina, who suffers from an eating disorder. However, Armaan manages to make her eat. But he later gets into trouble when the police hold him responsible for his ex-girlfriend's suicide attempt.

videos.title: Armaan Goes to Jail
videos.overview: Despite Armaan's clarifications, police arrest him and take Riddhima's statement. Afterwards, Armaan is released and Shashank asks everyone not to disclose Armaan's incident publically. However, Riddhima continues to hold Armaan responsible for Maya's condition.

videos.title: Riddhima Testifies Against Armaan
videos.overview: After Riddhima sees Armaan holding a knife pointed at Maya, she tells the police that Armaan tried to kill Maya. In the meantime, one of the accident patients misbehaves with Riddhima and she slaps him. Disturbed, Riddhima then gets more upset after she hears Maya's telephonic conversation.

videos.title: Riddhima Proves Armaan's Innocence
videos.overview: On learning the truth about Maya, Riddhima teams up with Atul to prove Armaan's innocence. However, Maya falls into Riddhima's trap and confesses to framing Armaan. Even though Armaan is freed of the charges against him, will he forgive Riddhima for sending him to jail?

videos.title: Armaan Refuses to Forgive Riddhima
videos.overview: Even though Riddhima apologises to Armaan, he refuses to accept the same. Afterwards, she tries to talk to him at his party, but he gets furious and scolds her. Later, while returning home, Vivek catches Riddhima and misbehaves with her. Will Armaan come to save Riddhima?

videos.title: Sanjeevani's Medical Camp
videos.overview: After Kirti, Armaan and Riddhima's operation, Shashank and Kirti talk about the upcoming medical camp. Although Armaan has not accepted Riddhima's apology, she gets a chance again as she and Armaan are set to travel together to reach the medical camp. Will Armaan finally forgive her?

videos.title: Armaan Troubles Riddhima
videos.overview: During their journey to the medical camp, Armaan purposely irritates Riddhima. On reaching the camp site, the Sanjeevani doctors and interns start attending to the villagers. Riddhima and Armaan also offer their services to the villagers.

videos.title: Anjali Frames Armaan
videos.overview: Everyone except Anjali supports Riddhima's idea to open a social service ward in the hospital. An offended Anjali then tries to trouble Riddhima and blames it on Armaan. Later, Armaan, Riddhima, Atul and Anjali play truth and dare. Will Armaan dare Riddhima to seek his revenge against her?

videos.title: Riddhima and Armaan Get Lost
videos.overview: Riddhima accepts Armaan's challenge of entering the forest in the dark. But once inside, she gets lost and is unable to find her way back. The local people and all the Sanjeevani doctors try to find her, but fail. Will Armaan safely bring back Riddhima from the forest?

videos.title: Riddhima and Armaan Find Their Way
videos.overview: Riddhima and Armaan finally find their way and reach the others who are waiting for them. At the hospital, while Riddhima works on Vijay's case, Armaan operates Mini. Later, Anjali feels jealous as Riddhima secures highest marks in the intern of the month competition.

videos.title: Armaan Teases Riddhima
videos.overview: After Riddhima and Anjali patch up, Armaan teases Riddhima for spending the entire night with him in the forest. However, Riddhima soon loses her peace when her patient, Vijay, suddenly starts bleeding and dies on the operation table. Will Riddhima be blamed for his death?

videos.title: Armaan Dreams About Riddhima
videos.overview: Armaan dreams of proposing to Riddhima and gets scared. Then, he feels her presence around him and the other interns make fun of him. Afterwards, Sapna hands over her medical case to Anjali and Kirti deducts ten points from Sapna's marks. Will Sapna hold this against Anjali?

videos.title: Riddhima Wins The Basketball Match
videos.overview: Although Padma wishes Anjali luck for the basketball match at Sanjeevani, the latter ignores her. During the game, Armaan gets distracted by Riddhima's beauty and her team wins the match. Did Armaan lose the match on purpose to make Riddhima happy?

videos.title: Armaan Tries to Woo Riddhima
videos.overview: After Anjali and Riddhima's argument over the basketball match, Riddhima gets irritated with Armaan's annoying behaviour. While the other interns handle their patients, Armaan discusses his problem with Atul. Does Atul have a solution to Armaan's problem?

videos.title: Riddhima Tricks Armaan
videos.overview: While Anjali prepares to win the intern contest, Armaan tells Riddhima that he has fallen for a girl, but she makes fun of him. Later, Armaan invites Riddhima for dinner. But instead of Riddhima, he finds his ex-girlfriends. Did Riddhima send his ex-girlfriends to him?

videos.title: Armaan Surprises Everyone
videos.overview: After Armaan surprises Atul, Sapna and Anjali with his behaviour towards Riddhima, Kirti assigns everyone's duty and appreciates Armaan for his work. Later, when Riddhima and Armaan get time, she asks him about his changed behaviour. Will Armaan confess his feelings to Riddhima?

videos.title: Anjali Gets Jealous Of Riddhima
videos.overview: While Riddhima is upset on learning about Mini's medical condition, Sapna gets annoyed as her parents emotionally blackmail her for marriage. Meanwhile, Anjali's jealousy towards Riddhima increases after the latter is again chosen as the intern of the month.

videos.title: Anjali Challenges Armaan
videos.overview: After Shashank allows Riddhima to assist him in his next surgery, she finds a love letter in her locker and doubts Armaan for fooling around with her. Anjali learns about Armaan's love for Riddhima and challenges him to make Riddhima fall in love with him. Will Armaan accept her challenge?

videos.title: Shashank Gets Padma's Reports
videos.overview: While the entire staff of Sanjeevani hospital is confused with Armaan's changed behaviour, Riddhima doubts his real intentions. Later, Shashank learns that Padma is suffering from brain tumour. Will Shashank now convince Padma to reveal the truth to her daughter?

videos.title: A Surprise Party For Riddhima
videos.overview: Atul, Sapna and Anjali plan a surprise party for Riddhima and seek Armaan's help in bringing her to the party. At the party, as Sapna feels sad on seeing Shubanker dance with his wife, Riddhima feels shy as Armaan invites her for a dance. Is Armaan doing all this to win Anjali's challenge?

videos.title: Riddhima Disappoints Armaan
videos.overview: While dancing with Riddhima at the party, Armaan reminds her about her promise and asks her out for a movie. However, she invites the other interns too. Meanwhile, Shashank tells Padma that they will have to tell the truth to Riddhima and Anjali. What are they talking about?

videos.title: Armaan Expresses His Love
videos.overview: After the movie, Armaan drops Riddhima home. But on their way, they share some romantic moments and Riddhima begins to understand her love for Armaan. However, she feels shy when Armaan expresses his feelings towards her. Will she express hers too?

videos.title: Anjali Spoils Riddhima's Date
videos.overview: Even though Riddhima commits to meeting Armaan in the evening, Anjali spoils their plan. Later, Riddhima even tries to express her feelings for Armaan to Anjali, but fails. In the meantime, Shashank fears for Padma's life as she feels dizzy. Will Shashank reveal the truth to Anjali and Riddhima?

videos.title: Shashank Tells Dadi About Padma
videos.overview: While Shashank tells Dadi about Padma's health and his decision to tell the truth to his daughters, Armaan pretends to leave Sanjeevani to make Riddhima express her feelings. Just when she is about to express her love for him, Armaan and Riddhima get to know that Mini is in critical condition.

videos.title: Armaan Becomes Emotional
videos.overview: Armaan and Kirti get into an argument when she tells him that he is getting emotional about Mini's case. However, Shahshank intervenes and scolds Armaan for disrespecting his senior. Later, Armaan breaks down on seeing Mini's condition. Will Riddhima help him cope with this tragedy?

videos.title: Padma has Brain Tumour
videos.overview: After Mini gains consciousness, Armaan decides to bear her treatment expenses in London. Meanwhile, Shashank informs Padma about her tests and tells her that her treatment for brain tumour needs to start immediately. Will Padma's illness unite her with Anjali and Riddhima?

videos.title: Padma's Farewell
videos.overview: Padma resigns from her post and gives Shashank the reasons for doing so. As Shashank arranges for her treatment at Malhotra hospital, Riddhima organises a farewell dinner for Padma at her house. When will Riddhima learn the truth about her relationship with Padma?

videos.title: Sanjeevani Doctors Play Dandiya
videos.overview: Armaan and Riddhima spend some romantic moments in and out of the hospital. Later, the doctors of Sanjeevani visit Sapna's house on the occasion of dandiya. There too, Riddhima and Armaan share romantic moments as the guests dance to the dandiya beats.

videos.title: Anjali's Bet
videos.overview: While Anjali takes back her bet and asks Armaan to stop playing with Riddhima's heart, Riddhima overhears their conversation and leaves the place. Even though Armaan tries to talk to Riddhima and express his true feelings, she ignores him. Will he succeed in convincing her?

videos.title: Riddhima Slaps Armaan
videos.overview: While the doctor informs Shashank that Padma is in a critical condition, Armaan takes Atul's help in reaching out to Riddhima to clarify the misunderstanding. Armaan keeps trying, but fails. Finally, he gets into Riddhima's house, but she slaps him instead. Will her slap deter Armaan's intentions?

videos.title: Riddhima Ignores Armaan
videos.overview: Despite Armaan's efforts, Riddhima refuses to listen to him and asks him to leave her alone. However, Sanjeevani brings them together as they are to treat a patient, who has been shot by a bullet on his shoulder. Will personal differences affect their professional relationship?

videos.title: Armaan Fakes an Accident
videos.overview: Armaan seeks Riddhima's forgiveness by standing outside her house the entire night. Meanwhile, Padma's health deteriorates and Shashank takes her to another hospital. Later, Armaan meets with an accident. How will Riddhima react when she learns about his accident?

videos.title: Armaan Learns Shashank's Secret
videos.overview: Armaan succeeds in his ‘accident’ plan and becomes happy on seeing Riddhima's concern for him. As Armaan's condition improves, he gets shifted to the general ward. Meanwhile, Armaan overhears Shashank telling someone that Riddhima is not his daughter.

videos.title: Armaan Tries to Win Over Riddhima
videos.overview: After hearing Shashank's conversation and learning Riddhima's real identity, Armaan takes Atul's help in this matter and they agree to not disclose the truth to Riddhima. However, he is left hurt when he discovers that Riddhima is making fun of his feelings. How will Armaan win Riddhima back?

videos.title: Armaan and Riddhima Patch Up
videos.overview: Armaan takes a security personnel's help to spread the rumour that he has lost faith in his life and is going to commit suicide. Eventually, when Riddhima realizes that it was just a prank, she yells at Armaan. Despite their argument, they patch up and decide to stay friends.

videos.title: Armaan Confronts Shashank
videos.overview: Armaan is assigned an abortion case. He gets into an argument with the other doctors about whether to keep the baby or abort her pregnancy. While discussing the same with Shashank, Armaan accidently reveals that he is aware about Riddhima's birthmother. How will Shashank react to this?

videos.title: Anjali Catches Shashank's Lies
videos.overview: Anjali spots Shashank and asks him to meet her at Sanjeevani but he lies and tells her that he is out of town. Later, the doctors plan to go out for the night. However, on their way, Anjali spots Shashank's car. Will Anjali and Riddhima finally catch Shashank's lies?

videos.title: Armaan Rescues Shashank and Padma
videos.overview: Armaan comes to Shashank and Padma's rescue, when Anjali and Riddhima reach Padma's ward and find her with Shashank. Later, as Shashank thanks Armaan for controlling the situation, Anjali becomes suspicious and questions Shashank about Padma. Will Shashank tell Anjali the truth?

videos.title: Riddhima Confesses to Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima finally confesses her love to Armaan. On the other hand, despite Anjali pestering Shashank about Padma, he refuses to divulge the truth. Later, while searching for some documents in Shashank's room, Anjali finds some adoption papers. Does she now know Shashank's secret?

videos.title: Anjali Confronts Shashank
videos.overview: Anjali realises that either she or Riddhima is adopted. To clarify the same, she calls Shashank, but he rudely refuses to talk. She confronts Dadi, but she also makes excuses and escapes from the situation. Later, Anjali eavesdrops on Dadi and Shashank's conversation. Will she get her answers?

videos.title: Anjali Assumes She is Adopted
videos.overview: While Shashank gets nervous that Anjali knows about the adoption, the latter reveals the truth to Riddhima. On hearing this, Riddhima rushes back home. Later, Armaan meets Riddhima and becomes shocked on learning that Anjali has wrongfully assumed herself as adopted.

videos.title: Shashank Breaks His Silence
videos.overview: After Armaan, Riddhima, Atul and Sapna celebrate Anjali's birthday at their house, Riddhima and Anjali confront Shashank about the adoption papers. Shashank gives in and tells them about Riddhima's adoption and her relationship with Padma. How will Riddhima take this news?

videos.title: Riddhima is Annoyed With Armaan
videos.overview: While Armaan tries to get through to Riddhima, Padma tells Shashank that she has full faith in him. Later, Riddhima scolds Armaan for not telling her the truth earlier and Shashank informs her about Padma's medical condition. Will Riddhima take care of her mother?

videos.title: Armaan Guides Riddhima
videos.overview: After Armaan guides Riddhima in the right direction, she reaches Gill's nursing home and convinces Shashank to operate on Padma, as he had refused earlier due to nervousness. However, the operation is successful, and Riddhima and Shashank are both relieved.

videos.title: Diwali Celebrations At Sanjeevani
videos.overview: While everyone at Sanjeevani is busy celebrating Diwali, Kirti suspects that Shubanker is having an affair with Sapna. She then assigns all the interns their duties and asks them to be extra careful as it is Diwali and there could be emergencies coming in.

videos.title: Kirti Blames The Doctors For Dadu
videos.overview: After Kirti delegates all the responsibilities, Anjali and Riddhima find out that one of their patients, Dadu, is losing his pulse. Later, Dadu suffers from a heart stroke and his health deteriorates. Kirti blames the doctors for his condition and warns that their negligence will not be overlooked.

videos.title: Who is Responsible?
videos.overview: As Armaan, Riddhima, Atul, Sapna and Anjali worry over Dadu's condition, Harsh wishes to meet Dadu. Later, Kirti finds out that the reason behind Dadu's present condition is use of propranolol. She asks Riddhima, Anjali, Sapna and Atul to explain themselves. Which intern gave Dadu this medicine?

videos.title: Dr. Kirti Blames Herself
videos.overview: Dr. Kirti wants to know who gave propranolol to Dadu while Dr. Armaan suspects Dr. Ridhima. Dr. Shashank demands a confession from the culprit. Dr. Kirti says that she will probe the matter and blames herself for what has happened. Who is the culprit?

videos.title: Ridhima Admits to Her Mistake
videos.overview: Dr. Kirti comes to know that it is Dr. Ridhima who had given propranolol to Dadu. She is furious and blames Dr. Ridhima for Dadu’s deteriorating health. Dr. Shashank is shocked by what has happened. Finally, Dr. Ridhima admits her mistake.

videos.title: Armaan Seeks Atul's Help
videos.overview: Atul is concerned for Ridhima and helps her prepare for her viva voce. Dr. Kirti assigns Armaan and Anjali to handle Dadu’s case. Atul and Sapna are assigned to take care of Harsh and Sumit. Meanwhile, Armaan is not convinced that Ridhima could have made a mistake and seeks Atul’s help.

videos.title: A Basketball Game
videos.overview: Armaan waits for Ridhima in the basketball court and challenges her in a match. Harsh worries about his Dadu and asks Armaan about Ridhima. Meanwhile, Dr. Kirti introduces Simran to the other doctors. Armaan, Atul and Sapna request Dr. Kirti to allow Nana to participate in their game.

videos.title: Kirti Advises Armaan
videos.overview: Armaan tries to talk to Ridhima about the Diwali night, but she is in no mood to talk about that incident. Kirti tells Armaan to take the help of a doctor. Meanwhile, the lab technician tells Armaan about propranolol.  Sumit expresses his grief to Ridhima.

videos.title: Preparations For The Skit
videos.overview: Kirti tells Deshpande not to take part in the skit because of his health but he refuses to listen to her. Later, Kirti tells Ridhima that she can only be backstage. Shashank takes Padma to Delhi to have a second opinion. All the interns prepare for the skit.

videos.title: Ridhima Explains to Armaan
videos.overview: Everyone, including Armaan, is concerned about Ridhima taking the blame for Anjali’s fault. Armaan asks Ridhima for an explanation. She tells him that Anjali made the mistake. Armaan wants to know why Ridhima is sacrificing her career for Anjali.

videos.title: Dr.subhankar's Daughter
videos.overview: Armaan and Ridhima, along with Atul, Anjali, Sapna, Simran and Nana, practise for their play. Sapna gets nervous in front of Dr. Subhanker and forgets her dialogues. Anjali is upset because Dr. Kirti gets the role of Soni. Meanwhile, Sapna is shocked to learn that Dr. Subhanker has a daughter.

videos.title: Ridhima's Viva Voce
videos.overview: Everyone conveys their best wishes to Ridhima. Kirti conducts Ridhima’s viva. Meanwhile Armaan, Anjali, Atul and Sapna make fun of Ridhima. But in spite of all odds Ridhima clears the test.

videos.title: The Doctors Stage a Play
videos.overview: All the doctors participate in a play. Sapna is chosen for Soni's role. During the play, Atul forgets his lines. Meanwhile, Armaan keeps staring at Riddhima, while Dr Shashank, Padma and Dadi enjoy the play. Will Riddhima and Armaan get closer?

videos.title: Shashank is Proud Of Riddhima
videos.overview: Shashank tells Riddhima that he is proud of her because she got over the bad phases in her career. Meanwhile, Atul and Anjali get stuck in the lift. Later, Kirti and Shubhankar have a friendly fight, while Armaan and Riddhima pull each other’s legs. What happens in the lift?

videos.title: Sapna Sees an Orphan Child
videos.overview: Kirti assigns each doctor to different wards. In the midst of her assignment, Sapna sees an orphan child and feels sad. Meanwhile, Kirti and Subhankar discuss their past. Later, Armaan asks everyone out for a cup of coffee. Will Riddhima accept the offer?

videos.title: Armaan Calls Riddhima and Lies
videos.overview: Armaan and Atul look after patients during their night duty. Armaan calls Riddhima and lies to her about an emergency. Riddhima rushes to the hospital to take care of the patients while Armaan sleeps. Later, Sapna talks about the orphan child to Shubhankar. Will Armaan's bluff be caught?

videos.title: Kirti Scolds Riddhima
videos.overview: Kirti scolds Riddhima for fighting with Armaan in the hospital and violating the rules of Sanjeevani. To get her revenge, Riddhima keeps Armaan's mobile phone ringer on. Later, during a meeting, Armaan's phone rings and Dr. Kirti gets infuriated. Will Armaan find out that Riddhima was behind it?

videos.title: Manjulika Slaps Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima tries to put down Armaan in front of Kirti. She also manipulates Manjulika and makes her slap Armaan. Armaan pretends to be injured by the slap. Meanwhile, Atul thinks that Anjali is in love with him. Riddhima calls Armaan. What does she tell him?

videos.title: A Stranger Attacks Riddhima
videos.overview: Riddhima plays a prank on Armaan. Later, Riddhima is attacked by an unknown person. Meanwhile, Anjali and Atul ask their patient to quit smoking the hookah. Later, a patient flirts with Riddhima and that makes Armaan jealous. Who attacked Riddhima and why?

videos.title: Chaos At The Hospital
videos.overview: An unfortunate bus accident sends Sanjeevani into a tizzy. Kirti summons all the doctors to tend to the survivors of the accident. Armaan and Riddhima find themselves tending to patients in the same room. Will their fights have an adverse effect on the patients?

videos.title: Armaan and Atul Win The Match
videos.overview: Armaan and Atul challenge Riddhima, Anjali and Sapna to a Basketball match. The girls play well and take a lead but Armaan plays dirty and the boys win. As per the rules of the bet they placed, the boys demand Armaan's prize. What was the bet?

videos.title: Riddhima Accuses Armaan
videos.overview: Armaan doesn't kiss Riddhima as per the bet. Strangely, this disappoints Riddhima. Later, Armaan and Riddhima go out. Armaan loses his way and Riddhima accuses Armaan of trying to take advantage of her. This upsets Armaan and he tells Ridhima that he will stay away from her. Will he?

videos.title: Armaan and Riddhima Reach Lonavla
videos.overview: Armaan and Riddhima reach Lonavala to check on the kids in the orphanage. They take a liking to Armaan and later figure that there is a dispute between Armaan and Riddhima. Riddhima continues to be rude to Armaan, so he leaves her alone. Will she miss him?

videos.title: Goons Misbehave With Riddhima
videos.overview: Dr. Rahul Garewal enters Sanjeevani. Meanwhile, Armaan gives Muskaan a lift to Mumbai. Some goons misbehave with Riddhima while she's travelling in a bus. Later, when Armaan figures that he may have to work with Riddhima, he requests to be placed with someone else. Does Riddhima escape the goons?

videos.title: Armaan and Rahul Remember College
videos.overview: Armaan and Rahul Garewal remember their college days. Armaan gets angry when Riddhima takes sides with Rahul. Meanwhile, Muskaan creates chaos when she enters Sanjivani. Later, Shubhankar sees Dr. Shashank talking to nurse Padma. Does Shubhankar suspect that something is amiss about Shashank and Padma?

videos.title: Sumit Goes Missing
videos.overview: Atul sees Rahul talking to Anjali and feels jealous. Meanwhile, Armaan speaks to Sumit who confesses that he loves Riddhima. Later, Sumit goes missing and Kirti scolds everyone for negligence. Where has Sumit gone? Did Armaan do something to him in a fit of jealousy?

videos.title: Rahul and Armaan Plan a Bike Race
videos.overview: Amit lies about his illness and Atul suggests calling Shubhankar. Sumit calls up Riddhima to confess his love for her. He adds that he will never come back to the hospital. Later, Armaan and Rahul agree for a bike race. Does Riddhima convince Sumit?

videos.title: Shubhankar Questions Amit's Lies
videos.overview: Padma arrives at Shashank's house, while everybody is discussing the bike race between Armaan and Rahul. Meanwhile, Shubhankar figures that Amit is lying and asks him why. Amit confesses that he loves Sapna. Just before the race, Anjali, Atul, Sapna and Muskaan cheer for Armaan. Will Riddhima cheer for him too?

videos.title: Dr Shashank Scolds The Interns
videos.overview: Atul asks Armaan to teach him to ride a bike. Meanwhile, Amit thanks Shubhankar for his help and support. Later, Shashank and Kirti call all the interns for a meeting. In the meeting, Shashank questions everyone on the race. Will the race be cancelled?

videos.title: Armaan Loses The Race to Rahul
videos.overview: Armaan and Rahul begin their race. Meanwhile, Riddhima tells Atul that she is not interested in Armaan. During the race, Atul shows a placard to Armaan with Riddhima's statement. Armaan falls off the bike and Rahul wins. Armaan is brought to the hospital unconscious. Will he be alright?

videos.title: Armaan Learns Of Riddhima's Care
videos.overview: Shashank advises Armaan, not to let his personal and professional lives affect each other. Atul tells Armaan that Riddhima tended to him and never left his side. At the New Year Party, Riddhima feels unhappy and goes to the terrace. She is surprised to see someone on the terrace. Who?

videos.title: Riddhima Runs Away From Armaan
videos.overview: Shaken by the romantic side of Armaan, Riddhima runs away. Later, Rahul and Muskaan get stuck in the store room and are found by the ward boy the next morning. Shubhankar observes Sapna with Amit. Riddhima takes care of Armaan and he praises her. Are Armaan and Riddhima in love?

videos.title: Armaan is Intern Of The Month
videos.overview: Riddhima overhears a conversation between Anjali and Muskan. Meanwhile, Kirti asks Rahul to stay in the general ward with Anjali. Later, Shashank announces Armaan as the 'Intern of the month'. What did Riddhima overhear? How will the other interns react to Armaan's success?

videos.title: Armaan Gets a Scolding
videos.overview: Dr. Kirti scolds Armaan for coming late and tells him that he has to be tougher. Muskaan rants at Rahul as he provokes everyone against Armaan. Later, Armaan asks Ridhima to help him in Gappu’s appendix treatment.

videos.title: Armaan Comforts Ridhima
videos.overview: Armaan comforts Ridhima and apologises for hurting her. Ridhima tells Armaan that they will not disclose their relationship to anyone. Dr. Kirti congratulates Armaan for his good work as a monitor. Rahul taunts Armaan.

videos.title: Armaan and Riddhima are In Love
videos.overview: Armaan and Riddhima confess their love for each other. Meanwhile, Shashank is happy about Padma's return to the hospital. Later, jealous on seeing Riddhima talking to Rahul, Armaan forces her to express her love in front of everyone. Will Riddhima agree?

videos.title: Armaan and Ridhima Fight
videos.overview: Armaan asks Ridhima to confess his love to him in front of everybody. However, she refuses to do so. Shashank asks Armaan about Muskaan being allotted duty in the OT. Sapna tells everybody that she is getting married soon. Armaan is angry with Ridhima for agreeing to dance with Rahul.

videos.title: Rahul Lies About His Birthday
videos.overview: Rahul lies to convince Riddhima that it's his birthday. Meanwhile, Armaan briefs and allocates work to everyone as he is the monitor. Kirti gives Armaan feedback received from all the interns about his performance as a monitor. Later, Riddhima makes plans for Rahul's birthday. How will Armaan react?

videos.title: Rahul Takes Riddhima Out
videos.overview: Rahul asks Riddhima out. She escapes and asks Armaan to pick her up from the parking lot. However, Rahul reaches there before Armaan and takes Riddhima with him. Armaan gets upset about this and misunderstands Riddhima. Is Riddhima encouraging Rahul's attention?

videos.title: Armaan's Monitor Duty is Over
videos.overview: Riddhima asks Armaan to do 500 push-ups to prove his love for her. Later, Armaan gets upset when Riddhima is selected as Rahul's dance partner. Meanwhile, Naaniji tells Anjali that Shashank likes Padma. Shashank asks Dr. Kirti to take charge since Armaan's duty as monitor is over.

videos.title: Riddhima Keeps a Gift For Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima keeps a gift for Armaan in his locker and finds some paper with her name written on it. Armaan is shocked when Muskaan asks him to act as her boyfriend. Nani and Anjali plan to force Shashank and Padma to attend Sapna's marriage. Will Armaan agree to Muskaan's request?

videos.title: Sapna's Wedding Ceremony
videos.overview: Armaan and Riddhima attend Sapna's wedding. Later, Muskaan requests Armaan's help. Meanwhile, Shashank is elated to see Padma at the wedding. Shubhankar feels happy to see Shashank and Padma together. Will Armaan comply with Muskaan's request? Will Shashank and Padma accept their feelings?

videos.title: Armaan Gifts a Bangle to Riddhima
videos.overview: Armaan gifts Riddhima an ancestral bangle declaring that he wants to spend the rest of his life with her. Muskaan's parents arrive to meet her boyfriend. They mistake Armaan to be Muskaan's boyfriend. Will this mistake cause fissures in Armaan and Riddhima's relationship?

videos.title: Padma Lies About The Bangle
videos.overview: Shashank and Anjali ask Riddhima about the bangle that Armaan gifted her, but she lies about it. Later, Padma asks Armaan about his idea of a wife. Armaan jokingly lists down things that Riddhima hears and gets angry. How long will Armaan and Riddhima hide their relationship from everyone?

videos.title: Rahul Admires Riddhima's Outfit
videos.overview: Rahul admires and praises Riddhima in her marriage outfit. Armaan gets jealous and angry. Armaan's behaviour irritates Riddhima and she refuses to receive his calls. Armaan visits Riddhima's house to pacify her and is stunned. What did Armaan find so shocking?

videos.title: Muskaan's Grandmother is Serious
videos.overview: Worried about not being able to control her feelings, Riddhima makes every possible attempt to avoid confronting Armaan. Later, Muskaan's mother informs them about her grandmother's critical condition and asks her to come home with her boyfriend, Armaan, immediately. What will Armaan do now?

videos.title: Muskaan's Parents Summon Armaan
videos.overview: Rahul's constant compliments to Riddhima irritate Armaan. Muskaan's parents repeatedly ask her to come home with her boyfriend, Armaan. Armaan wishes to be of help to Muskaan. However, he fears that doing so might jeopardise his relationship with Riddhima. What will Armaan decide to do?

videos.title: Armaan Agrees to Help Muskaan
videos.overview: A girl tries to flirt with Armaan. Riddhima notices this and is jealous. Later, Armaan requests for leave to go with Muskaan to meet her parents. Muskaan is overjoyed to know that Armaan is helping her. Has Armaan done the right thing?

videos.title: Muskaan Discovers The Truth
videos.overview: Muskaan and Armaan reach her village where they discover that her father lied to her about her grandmother's health. Meanwhile, Padma and Shashank discuss the Silver Jubilee celebration of Sanjivani. Later, Shubhankar asks Kirti to have coffee with him. Why did Muskaan's father lie to her?

videos.title: Rahul Flirts With Riddhima
videos.overview: Thinking Armaan is Muskaan's boyfriend, her family teases Armaan. Meanwhile, Rahul tries to flirt with Riddhima. He tells Riddhima about Armaan's college days. He narrates incidents about Armaan. Will Riddhima believe Rahul? Will Rahul be able to impress Riddhima?

videos.title: Armaan and Riddhima Feel Lonely
videos.overview: Despite the Lohri celebrations in Muskaan's home town, Armaan feels lonely without Riddhima. Riddhima too misses Armaan. They try to contact each other on phone but in vain. Later, Muskaan realizes something about Armaan. Is Muskaan developing feelings for Armaan?

videos.title: Rahul Answers Riddhima's Phone
videos.overview: Armaan is shocked when he calls up Riddhima and Rahul answers her phone. Armaan decides to return the next day, but Muskaan's relatives refuse to let him go. Meanwhile, Rahul continues to impresses Riddhima. Kirti informs Muskaan that they are in Chandigarh to celebrate Sanjeevani's anniversary.

videos.title: Armaan Wears a Turban to Hide
videos.overview: Armaan is surprised when Muskaan tells him about the Sanjeevani's silver jubilee celebrations in Chandigarh. To avoid being identified by anyone, he wears a turban. Later, in the bus stand, Riddhima sees Armaan. Will Riddhima be able to identify him?

videos.title: Armaan Sees Riddhima In a Market
videos.overview: The doctors decide to go to a Gurudwara. Coincidentally, Muskaan's family too goes there. Muskaan is shocked to see Riddhima in the Gurudwara. Later, Muskaan and Armaan go out to shop. Armaan sees Riddhima. Will Armaan and Riddhima come across each other?

videos.title: Peshab Singh Attacks The Doctors
videos.overview: Armaan feels jealous on seeing Rahul and Riddhima together. He gets furious and believes that Riddhima has grown close to Rahul. Riddhima tries to convince Armaan that it is not so. Meanwhile, a dreaded Bandit, Peshab Singh, attacks the Sanjeevani staff bus. How will they escape?

videos.title: The Goons Act As The Kauravas
videos.overview: The goons don the role of the Kauravas and force everyone to act as characters from the Mahabharata. They proceed to enact the 'cheer-haran' of Muskaan, who is playing the role of Draupadi. Armaan tries to stop them. Will the goons harm Muskaan?

videos.title: Armaan Kisses Riddhima
videos.overview: Armaan apologises to Riddhima for misunderstanding her, but she does not forgive him. Later, Gappu, a patient tricks them and makes Armaan kiss Ridhima. Meanwhile, the girls gather at Kirti's house to celebrate Valentine's Day without the boys. Will the boys follow suit?

videos.title: Valentine's Day At Kirti's House
videos.overview: Armaan visits Kirti's house dressed as a pizza delivery boy to meet Riddhima. The boys enter from three different directions and meet their respective girlfriends at Kirti's house. Later, Kirti and Shubhankar cut a cake and start dancing. Will Armaan and Riddhima join them?

videos.title: Armaan Hugs Muskaan Accidentally
videos.overview: Armaan gifts Riddhima a chain and Riddhima gives him comics in return. Shashank sends white flowers to Padma as a gift for Valentine's Day. Later, Armaan mistakes Muskaan to be Riddhima and hugs her. Rahul sees Armaan hugging Muskaan. Will Rahul use this against Armaan?

videos.title: Anonymous Dedication to Riddhima
videos.overview: An anonymous person publishes a dedication to Riddhima in a daily newspaper. Armaan reads this and gets jealous. He seeks help from one of his journalist friends to find out who got the dedication published. Later, Armaan's friend finds out and informs Armaan. Who published the dedication?

videos.title: Armaan Gets Furious With Rahul
videos.overview: Muskaan misses Armaan and plans to ask Kirti for suggestions on getting Armaan to reciprocate her feelings. Meanwhile, Armaan is fuming over Rahul's behaviour and attempts to impress Riddhima. Armaan decides to inform everyone about his relationship with Riddhima. How will Riddhima react to this?

videos.title: Armaan Opens Up About His Affair
videos.overview: Armaan tells everyone about his relationship with Riddhima. Later, when Riddhima is angry at him for opening up about their affair, Armaan keeps teasing her. Padma catches Armaan staring at Riddhima. Meanwhile, Rahul learns about Armaan’s marriage to Muskaan.

videos.title: Rahul Knows About Patiala Trip
videos.overview: Armaan is shocked to learn that Rahul is aware about his trip to Patiala with Muskaan. Later, Rahul offers a lift to Riddhima, but Armaan forbids her from going with him. Armaan is restless and decides to tell the truth to Riddhima, but is not able to tell her.

videos.title: Rahul Warns Armaan
videos.overview: Rahul asks Armaan not to hurt Muskaan’s feelings. He warns him of severe consequences if he plays with her life. However, Muskaan asks Rahul to stay out of her personal affairs. Meanwhile, Dr Kirti and Dr Shubhankar decide to go on a coffee date.

videos.title: Doctors Steal Medicines
videos.overview: A few of the doctors steal medicines from Sanjeevani for their respective private practices. Some staff members inform Abhimanyu about it. Meanwhile, those doctors operate on a woman in the hospital without Abhimanyu’s permission.

videos.title: Rahul Tells The Truth to Riddhima
videos.overview: Armaan waits for Riddhima at the party. He is in for a pleasant surprise as Riddhima has decided to admit her love towards him in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Rahul tries to warn Muskaan about Armaan and ends up telling the same to Riddhima.

videos.title: Ridhima Ignores Armaan
videos.overview: Ridhima taunts Rahul and decides to have a chat with Armaan. She sees Muskaan giving Armaan a bracelet and misunderstands him. Armaan becomes suspicious when he sees Rahul taking Ridhima home. However, Ridhima ignores Armaan.

videos.title: Muskaan Falls For Armaan
videos.overview: Armaan tries to tell Ridhima about his Punjab trip with Muskaan, but she refuses to listen and shouts at him. Later, he calls her up but she doesn’t answer the phone. Meanwhile, Muskaan is madly in love with Armaan. Tension brews up between Armaan and Ridhima.

videos.title: Armaan Resigns From Sanjeevani
videos.overview: Dr Shubhankar helps Anjali, Riddhima, Muskaan, Rahul & Atul in hiding his plants from Dr Kirti. However, Dr Kirti catches the interns with the plants & scolds them. They learn from Dr Kirti about Armaan's resignation. Riddhima tries her best to contact Armaan over phone but fails to reach him.

videos.title: Rahul Goes In Search Of Armaan
videos.overview: Rahul is upset as he convinces a dejected Muskaan who tells him that she loves Armaan. Rahul decides to go in search of Armaan. Meanwhile, Padma consoles Riddhima, who is worried about Armaan.

videos.title: Suspension Letter For Armaan
videos.overview: Shashank takes Padma out for dinner. Anjali feels happy when Dadi tells her about it. Meanwhile, Dr Shubhankar and Dr Kirti are upset that Armaan has quit Sanjeevani without any notice. However, Shashank orders Dr Kirti to type a suspension letter for Armaan.

videos.title: Rahul Meets Armaan
videos.overview: Rahul meets Armaan and convinces him to return to Sanjeevani, but he refuses. Back in Sanjeevani, a baffled Muskaan tells everyone that Dr. Kirti and Dr. Shashank have decided to suspend Armaan. The interns request Dr. Shashank to change his decision.

videos.title: Ridhima is Harassed
videos.overview: Armaan loses a fight, when he gets distracted on seeing Ridhima. Afterwards, she convinces Armaan to come back, but he ignores her.  Meanwhile, Ridhima gets upset and when she is returning, a few thugs harass her.

videos.title: Armaan and Ridhima Get Close
videos.overview: Armaan saves Ridhima from the goons and drops her to the guest house. Ridhima decides to take Armaan with her to Mumbai. Armaan and Ridhima grow close to each other.

videos.title: Love or Friendship?
videos.overview: Armaan gets disappointed when Ridhima tells him that she is not sure about him and considers him a friend. Ridhima makes Armaan agree to travel to Mumbai with her. Later, he informs Ridhima that he will be just a friend to her.

videos.title: Nana is Back In Hospital
videos.overview: Ridhima saves Armaan’s patient’s life while he is away. However, he taunts her instead of thanking her. Ridhima gets hurt at this. Deboo is attracted to Anjali. Dr. Kirti assigns Ridhima and Armaan to handle Nana’s case when he is admitted back to Sanjeevani.

videos.title: Ridhima is Upset
videos.overview: Ridhima is upset because Armaan requests Dr. Kirti to assign him any intern but not Ridhima. Dr. Kirti doesn’t agree. Dr. Shashank addresses the interns and says that he will declare the ‘Intern of the Month’ shortly.

videos.title: Armaan is Happy Again
videos.overview: The interns are glad to see Armaan happy again. However, he starts irritating Riddhima with his pranks. Later, it is learnt that Armaan has feelings for Ridhima, but he plans to teach her a lesson.

videos.title: Ridhima Loses Her Pager
videos.overview: Armaan finds Riddhima’s pager in the locker room and keeps it with himself. Meanwhile, Ridhima is upset because she cannot find her pager. Dr. Kirti becomes angry seeing Armaan and Ridhima submitting two different reports pertaining to the same case.

videos.title: A Letter For Riddhima
videos.overview: A patient falls for Anjali. For Ridhima, it’s another bad hair day at Sanjeevni, and Armaan makes it worse with his pranks. Enraged, Ridhima shouts at Armaan to stop his buffoonery. Later, Ridhima is shocked to find a letter in her locker.

videos.title: Armaan is Injured
videos.overview: Ridhima finds Armaan soaked in blood and tries to help him, but again they end up quarrelling. Later, Ridhima is upset about the incident, and Armaan, still in a rage, injures himself in a practice fight session.

videos.title: Intern Of The Month
videos.overview: Anjali realises that something is wrong with Ridhima and asks her about it. Ridhima tells her about her relationship without revealing Armaan’s identity.  The next day, Ridhima is named as the ‘Intern of the Month’ at Sanjeevani.

videos.title: Nana Advises Armaan
videos.overview: Armaan is upset about Ridhima. Nana talks to him and suggests that he should mend his relationship with her. As the 'Intern of the Month', Ridhima is authorised to take the daily briefing sessions instead of Dr. Kirti.

videos.title: Ridhima Lands In Hot Water
videos.overview: Dr. Kirti finds Atul hiding under a bed in the ward. Later, she catches Rahul, who pretends to be Muskaan, and assists in an operation. Later, Dr. Kirti pulls up Riddhima for not monitoring her team well.

videos.title: Holi Celebrations
videos.overview: Anjali manages to convince Ridhima to play Holi. Armaan and Rahul help Atul practise how to play Holi with Anjali. Ridhima, Rahul, Muskaan, Atul, Anjali, Dr. Shubankar and Dr. Kirti dance madly after having bhang-filled ladoos. Armaan is elated as Ridhima proposes to him.

videos.title: Dr. Shashank is Shocked
videos.overview: Armaan is super excited that Ridhima has proposed to him. Dr. Shashank is shocked when he comes to know that bhang was doing the rounds during the Holi festivities.

videos.title: Shashank Warns Armaan
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank is upset with Kirti and Shubankar for giving too much freedom to the team of doctors during Holi. Ridhima reveals to Shashank that Armaan brought drugs for the celebrations. Shashank lets him go with a warning.

videos.title: Flowers For Dr. Kirti
videos.overview: Armaan and Ridhima avoid speaking to each other. Ridhima assigns her colleagues their respective duties for the day. Atul arranges for flowers to be sent to Anjali. The flowers reach Dr. Kirti’s cabin and she assumes that Dr. Shubhankar has sent them.

videos.title: Armaan's Negligence
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank insists that Armaan should check the ECG of a patient in the operation theatre, but he fails to do so, as he is distracted with Ridhima's thoughts.  Dr. Shashank and Dr. Kirti yell at Armaan for his negligence.

videos.title: Armaan's Apology
videos.overview: Shehnaaz mistakenly believes that Armaan is in love with Anjali. Armaan apologises to Shashank. Later, Shashank advises Armaan to work out his priorities. Armaan refuses to seek Ridhima’s help.  He tells her there is nothing left to discuss.

videos.title: Armaan Argues With Ridhima
videos.overview: Armaan argues with Ridhima when she tries to advise him. His grandmother, who is visiting, figures out that Ridhima is the girl he is in love with. Atul is upset as he comes to know that someone has gifted a mirror to Anjali.

videos.title: Armaan is Angry
videos.overview: Shehnaaz and Ridhima plan to cheer up Armaan. Atul dreams that Anjali is cheering for him while he competes in a street fight. Armaan is angry with Ridhima for putting up posters promoting his street fight competition against Balli without his consent.

videos.title: The Street Fight Competition
videos.overview: Armaan is beaten up by Balli in the street fight competition. Then, when Balli hurts Ridhima, Armaan beats Balli and wins the street fight competition. Rahul extends his support to Shehnaaz and Ridhima decides to conduct a bike race to cheer up Armaan.

videos.title: Armaan Takes Part In a Bike Race
videos.overview: Rahul and Ridhima put up Armaan to compete in the bike race. Muskaan is curious to know the reason behind Rahul instigating Armaan to participate in the race. Kirti reveals to Shashank about Ridhima’s involvement in conducting sports events like boxing and bike racing.

videos.title: Armaan Wins The Bike Race
videos.overview: Armaan and Rahul compete against each other in a bike race. Ridhima rides pillion with Armaan and they fall off the bike. Armaan tells her to hold on to him tight and he wins the race.

videos.title: Riddhima Gets a Warning
videos.overview: Dr. Shubhankar is mesmerised as he watches Dr. Kirti Mehra. Dr. Shashank questions Riddhima about the decline in Armaan’s performance and tells her to concentrate on the interns instead of diverting their attention to extra-curricular activities.

videos.title: A Basketball Match
videos.overview: Shubankar and the team of doctors convince Kirti to hold a basketball match.  Atul and the team of doctors stage a drama to convince Armaan to participate in the match. Armaan accepts the challenge and agrees to participate.

videos.title: A Match Between Boys and Girls
videos.overview: The doctors split into men and women teams. It is decided that the losing team will act as servants to the winning team for a week. Armaan is injured while playing. Ridhima tells Atul that they should make Armaan believe this is a real match.

videos.title: The Men's Team Wins
videos.overview: The men win the basketball match. Armaan refuses to be a slave to the girls’ team and leaves the place. Ridhima promises Shehnaz that she will try her best to make Armaan smile. Will he let her do that?

videos.title: Ridhima is Off Monitor Duty
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank taunts Ridhima and Kirti for spending more time on extra-curricular activities and also relieves Ridhima from monitoring duty. She continues to irritate Armaan. Dr. Kirti shouts at Dr. Shubankar when he tries to praise her.

videos.title: Disciplining Ridhima
videos.overview: Armaan continues to be irritated by Ridhima. Dr. Shashank is shocked to see Ridhima massaging Armaan. Dr. Shashank calls Padma to his cabin and instructs her to keep Ridhima in check.

videos.title: Armaan Scares Ridhima
videos.overview: Ridhima dances for Armaan when he requests her to. Atul is shocked when he comes to know that Armaan was only pretending that he was angry. Armaan sends Ridhima on duty to the mortuary and scares her.

videos.title: Nana Shouts At Ridhima
videos.overview: Armaan manages to escape from Dr. Shubankar and Dr. Kirti. Atul tries to tell Ridhima about Armaan’s prank but doesn’t manage to do so. Nana shouts at Ridhima as she asks him questions given by Armaan.

videos.title: Ridhima Takes On Armaan
videos.overview: Ridhima mixes egg with oil and applies it to Armaan’s hair. She asks Atul to keep quiet when he comes to know that she is playing a prank on Armaan. Dr. Kirti taunts Armaan as the bad smell from his hair spreads across the hospital.

videos.title: Ridhima Irritates Armaan
videos.overview: Ridhima irritates Armaan by putting itching power in his coat and later by stealing his clothes when he is taking a bath. Dr. Shashank laughs at Armaan as he tries to get to the locker room wrapped in a blanket. Armaan is shocked when he sees his clothes are with Ridhima.

videos.title: Dr. Shubhankar is Happy
videos.overview: Armaan comes to know that Ridhima is also playing pranks on him. Shehnaaz supports Ridhima, asking her to take on Armaan and his pranks. Dr. Shubankar feels happy when Dr. Kirti tells him that she will miss him.

videos.title: Armaan's Birthday Party
videos.overview: Ridhima and her friends organise a party at the cafeteria for Armaan’s birthday. A cake fight ensues and some of it hits Dr. Shashank when he enters the cafeteria. He gets annoyed and says he will suspend all of them.

videos.title: Armaan and The Gang Get Suspended
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank punishes the interns by asking them to accompany Dr. Kirti to serve at the hermitage. Later, Dr. Shashank suspends Armaan and his friends for a week. After making a plan to follow the girls to Lonavala, Armaan and the gang go to meet Dr. Shubanker.

videos.title: Armaan and Friends Go to Lonavala
videos.overview: Armaan and the gang meet Dr. Shubanker and request him to help them carry out their plan. However, he refuses to do so. Later, they sow seeds of panic in Dr.Shashank’s mind by asking him to rush to Lonavala. Watch the episode to see how Armaan’s strategy to go to Lonavala pans out.

videos.title: The New Identitites
videos.overview: Dr. Kirti and the interns are surprised to see Dr. Shubanker in Lonavala. He introduces them to Armaan and his gang, who have disguised themselves as women. Later, Anjali goes to Savita to know about her future. Will she find who Savita and Gurmeet are?

videos.title: Armaan Dreams Of Ridhimma
videos.overview: While Ridhimma misses Armaan, he, as Gurmeet, feels uncomfortable to be in the room with her. Meanwhile, Dr. Shubhanker goes to meet Stella, who is Rahul, and gets angry at Arman and Atul for not helping him to impress Dr. Kirti. Later, Armaan imagines himself romancing with Ridhimma.

videos.title: Rahul is Angry With The Boys
videos.overview: Gurmeet and Savita are stupefied by Ridhimma and Anjali's beauty, respectively. However, Rahul gets angry with them for forgetting their real mission and instigate them to take their revenge against the girls. Later, the gang comes up with a plan to trap Ridhimma and her friends.

videos.title: Ridhimma and Friends are Stranded
videos.overview: Ridhimma, Anjali and Lovely reach a jungle in search of the temple. Meanwhile, Armaan and his friends disguise themselves as gangsters and reach there to scare them. However, a few thugs overhear their conversation and decide to trap them.

videos.title: The Joke Becomes Serious
videos.overview: Ridhimma learns about Armaan’s plan and the girls decide to get back at his monkey business. Meanwhile, the thugs beat up Armaan, Atul and Rahul and they lose consciousness. Later, Ridhimma puts herself in a dire situation by allowing the goons to kidnap her.

videos.title: Trouble For Ridhimma
videos.overview: Ridhimma herself dials up her father’s number, after which the goon demands a huge ransom. Meanwhile, Dr. Kirti gets a call from Dr. Shashank about the kidnapping. She scolds Anjali when she tells her about Ridhimma’s tit-for-tat prank. Who will rescue Ridhimma?

videos.title: Armaan Goes In Search Of Ridhimma
videos.overview: Armaan goes in search of Ridhimma while she asks her kidnappers to bring pizza and burger. However, upon realising that the kidnapper is Peshab Singh, she panics. Later, Armaan saves her from the kidnappers and they get back to their colleagues. How will Dr.Shashank react to the incident?

videos.title: Padma Wants to Take Ridhimma Back
videos.overview: Padma Gupta surprises Ridhimma and her colleagues by arriving at the Sanjeevani orphanage. Later, she seeks Dr. Shashank’s permission to take Ridhimma along with her to Chandigarh. Armaan is worried after learning that Ridhimma is going with her mother. How can he stop her?

videos.title: A Surprise For Armaan
videos.overview: Armaan is upset about Ridhimma’s absence and Rahul and Atul tease him for that. Armaan opens up to Rahul about his feelings for Ridhimma. Dr. Shashank talks to his students and colleagues about the importance of their presence in the hospital. Meanwhile, a pleasant surprise awaits Armaan.

videos.title: Armaan Apologises to Ridhimma
videos.overview: Dr.Shashank invites Armaan and Ridhimma for lunch at his house and asks them to call the other interns as well. However, Armaan, Atul, Rahul and Dr. Shubhanker are shocked after seeing only boiled vegetables for lunch. Later, Armaan apologises to Ridhimma for his prank.

videos.title: A Prank Call to Dr. Kirti
videos.overview: Armaan and Ridhimma share a light moment together as they decide to be friends. Later, they try to give some privacy for Atul and Anjali in the lab in order to bring them closer. Ridhimma calls up Dr. Kirti and pretends to be a patient to send her away from the hospital.

videos.title: Muskan has No Place to Stay
videos.overview: Armaan compels Dr. Shubhanker to act as if he had a heart attack. Dr. Kirti arrives at his house and later, laughs it off when she realises that it was a prank. Meanwhile, Muskan is upset as her landlady has sent back her luggage and that she doesn’t have a place to stay.

videos.title: Nani Makes a Revelation
videos.overview: Armaan, Atul and Rahul arrive at Ridhimma’s house to see Muskan. Later, Armaan, Atul, Rahul, Muskan and Ridhimma overhear Nani and Anjali's conversation regarding the wedding plans of Dr. Shashank and Padma. Atul and his colleagues get to know that they were a couple.

videos.title: Match-making In Progress
videos.overview: Ridhimma and her colleagues plan to bring Dr. Shashank and Padma close to each other, while Armaan assures to resolve Muskan’s issue. Ridhimma gifts Padma with a blue saree and insists her to wear it. Dr.Shashank compliments her looks.

videos.title: Dr. Kirti Learns About The Plan
videos.overview: Anjali, Ridhimma and Muskan invite Padma to the café through a letter. Armaan, Rahul and Atul seek Dr. Shubanker’s help in delivering a similar invite to Dr. Shashank. Padma and Dr. Shashank leave early from the hospital to meet at the café. Dr. Kirti comes to know about the plan.

videos.title: Padma Agrees to Marry Shashank
videos.overview: Dr. Shubanker is excited as Dr. Kirti agrees to send Padma to the restaurant. Armaan, Ridhimma, Atul, Anjali, Rahul and Muskan help Dr. Shashank and Pandma have a romantic evening. All the members of Sanjeevani celebrate as Padma agrees to marry Dr. Shashank.

videos.title: Shashank's Family Welcomes Padma
videos.overview: Dadi thinks that Dr. Shubanker and Dr. Kirti should be married. Dr. Shashank’s family welcomes Padma. Dr. Armaan, Dr. Shubanker, Dr. Atul and Dr. Rahul gift sarees to their respective girlfriends.

videos.title: The Engagement
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank and Padma get engaged by exchanging rings. Dadi announces that her farm house will be the venue for the wedding. Meanwhile, Armaan consoles an emotional Ridhimma. Rahul feels sad as Muskan informs that she is not attending the wedding. Why will she miss the wedding?

videos.title: Armaan Gifts Ridhimma a Saree
videos.overview: Ridhimma is jealous when Mallika makes advances to Armaan. Anjali consoles Ridhimma as she gets into an argument with Mallika. Later, Ridhimma helps Armaan in selecting a saree. Later, he gifts the saree to her and she feels happy. However, she is confused later.

videos.title: The Importance Of a Red Saree
videos.overview: Dadi tells Ridhimma about the importance of a red saree. Later, Ridhimma and Armaan share some romantic moments. Afterwards, Rahul sends Ridhimma and Armaan to pick up a bridal dress and helps them to spend some time alone.

videos.title: Ridhimma As a Bride
videos.overview: Armaan imagines Ridhimma in a bridal saree. Meanwhile, Ridhimma is jealous as Mallika tries to flirt with Armaan. Later, Armaan tells Rahul that Ridhimma is just a friend. Padma gets emotional as Armaan, Rahul and Atul identify themselves as the bride’s relatives.

videos.title: Muskan Comes Back
videos.overview: Armaan, Atul and Rahul try to disturb the girls’ rehearsal for the sangeet ceremony. Meanwhile, Muskan makes a surprise entry and Rahul is elated to see her. Later, Anjali, Ridhimma and Muskan make fun of the boys.

videos.title: Armaan Fears to Ask Ridhimma Out
videos.overview: Although Armaan has fallen head over heels in love with Riddhimma, he fails to work up the courage to ask her out. Meanwhile, it is celebration time at Dadi’s farmhouse and the haldi ritual is in progress, as a troupe of dancers make it all the more colourful with their performances.

videos.title: The Letter On Dr. Kirti's Palm
videos.overview: Padma is happy to see Armaan and Ridhimma together. Meanwhile, Dr. Shubanker feels elated to learn that Dr. Kirti has got the first letter of his name written on her palm with mehendi. Has Ridhimma got an ‘A’ on her palm?

videos.title: No Men Allowed
videos.overview: Anjali and Ridhimma ask Armaan and his friends to go out of the room as they are not allowed for the sangeet. Anjali plays the character of Dr. Shashank, while Ridhimma takes up Padma’s role. However, Armaan and Atul sneak into the room.

videos.title: The Wedding Ceremony
videos.overview: Everyone stops dancing when Dr. Shashank walks into the room. However, he praises the boys for their brilliant idea to take part in the sangeet and starts dancing with them. While Armaan and Atul help Padma with her make-up, Naani assists the groom.

videos.title: Padma's Bidaai
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank and Padma get married. Padma is emotional as she bids farewell and tells Armaan and Dr. Shubanker that they are more than brothers. Armaan and his friends gift the couple with a honeymoon package. Ridhimma thanks Armaan and asks him to spend some time with her.

videos.title: Girls can Dance Better
videos.overview: Muskan tells Atul that girls can dance better than boys. Later, Atul challenges the girls to dance with them for a song. Meanwhile, Arman meets up his friend Chirag who has come with his pregnant wife, Ritu, for a check-up. However, Chirag gets a sudden pain in his head and trips over.

videos.title: Chirag has Brain Tumour
videos.overview: Dr. Kirti is furious with Atul for lazing around during his duty hours and asks him to assist Armaan. Meanwhile, Armaan finds a blood clot in Chirag’s brain and suspects it to be a brain tumour. Armaan informs the same to Chirag. Chirag asks him not to tell Ritu about the same.

videos.title: Chirag to Go Under The Knife
videos.overview: Shubhankar eavesdrops on Muskan while she gives tips to Atul to woo Anjali. Armaan and Kirti inform Chirag that he has brain tumor and that he needs to go under the knife. They tell him that he may lose his memory after the surgery. Chirag refuses to have the surgery.

videos.title: Armaan is Ridhimma's Friend
videos.overview: Dr. Kirti, Dr. Shubankers and Dr. Paromita discuss Chirag’s MRI report. Ridhimma tells Armaan that she sees him as a friend. Later, Dr. Kirti tells Armaan that he cannot operate Chirag as they are close friends and that Anjali will assist Dr. Paromita in the surgery.

videos.title: Chirag's Surgery is a Success
videos.overview: During the surgery, Ridhimma suddenly leaves the operation theatre as she receives a message about Ritu. Later, Armaan is informed that the surgery was a success and that Chirag is out of danger. Ridhimma sees Ritu and Chirag together and remembers Armaan. Will she confess her love to him?

videos.title: Armaan Plans to Leave
videos.overview: Chirag gains consciousness, but loses his memory. Dr. Kirti and Armaan comfort Ritu, who breaks down in tears after learning about it. Meanwhile, Atul tries to make Anjali jealous by gifting flowers to Muskan. Later, Armaan tells everyone that he is leaving. Is he going away from Ridhimma?

videos.title: Armaan Buys a Rose For Ridhimma
videos.overview: Armaan remembers Ridhimma and buys a rose for her. Ridhimma searches for Armaan at the bus stop, but in vain. Later, she calls up Armaan and asks him not to go away from her. Can she convince him to cancel his trip?

videos.title: Riddhima Misses Armaan
videos.overview: Dr. Kirti allocates the shifts to all the doctors. Owing to Armaan’s absence, Ridhimma handles the general ward alone. Dr. Kirti asks Ridhimma to pay attention to her work. Meanwhile, Muskan helps Atul to impress Anjali. Ridhimma is worried thinking about Armaan. Will he come back to her?

videos.title: Ridhimma Goes Missing
videos.overview: Ridhimma misses Armaan. Meanwhile, Armaan recalls the moments with Ridhimma while consulting a girl at the new hospital he joined. Atul finds that Ridhimma is not there in the hospital. Where has she gone?

videos.title: Ridhimma Tries to Impress Armaan
videos.overview: Ridhimma tells Armaan that she cannot live without him. However, Armaan doesn’t confess his love for her. Meanwhile, Anjali, Atul and Muskan plan to impress Dr. Kirti. Ridhimma helps Armaan in his work to impress him.

videos.title: Ridhimma Plans to Commit Suicide
videos.overview: Ridhimma disguises herself as a villager and serves food to Armaan to woo him. Later, she snatches Armaan’s bag and makes him run after her across the village. However, Armaan tells him that he hates her. Disheartened by this, Ridhimma decides to commit to suicide.

videos.title: Armaan Professes His Love
videos.overview: Ridhimma drops her plan to commit suicide as Armaan professes his love to her. However, she slips and falls. But Armaan holds her hand and saves her. Later, they get stuck in the rains and take shelter in a deserted house. Armaan and Rdhima spend a romantic night together.

videos.title: Kirti Fumes At Ridhimma
videos.overview: The villagers bid farewell to Armaan and Ridhima. Later, Dr. Kirti fumes at Ridhimma for her irresponsible behaviour. She asks her to work with her for one week as a punishment.

videos.title: Armaan Romances With Riddhima
videos.overview: Atuls tells Muskan that Anjali is ignoring him. Meanwhile, Armaan romances with Ridhimma and then, hugs her. Anjali sees it but Armaan handles the situation well. Later, Muskan bumps into another doctor. Atul invites Anjali and Armaan for dinner.

videos.title: Ridhima is Angry With Armaan
videos.overview: Ridhimma and Armaan make excuses when the interns ask them to join for dinner. They go for the dinner separately. Later, Ridhimma becomes angry when Armaan tells her that she is his 31st girlfriend. Nevertheless, Armaan calms her down by his romantic talks.

videos.title: Atul and Armaan Gets Into a Fight
videos.overview: Armaan tactfully covers up his lie when he meets Dr. Shubhankar and Dr. Kirti in a party. However, Rahul feels that Armaan is hiding something. Later, Atul and Armaan fight with two boys, who try to misbehave with Ridhimma, due to which all of them are taken into police custody.

videos.title: Atul and Armaan Get Arrested
videos.overview: The police put Atul and Armaan in the lockup. Ridhimma convinces the inspector to call Dr. Shubankar. Later, Atul learns from his friends that Anjali loves him. Meanwhile, the police find Dr. Shubanker and Dr. Kirti outside the club and arrest them. Who will come to bail them out?

videos.title: Shashank Scolds Ridhimma
videos.overview: The inspector insults Armaan and his friends in front of Dr. Shashank. However, he bails them out and asks everyone to be at the hospital on time. Later, Dr. Shashank scolds Ridhimma for the whole incident. At night, Armaan sneaks into Ridhimma’s bedroom.

videos.title: Another Silly Prank
videos.overview: Atul tells Rahul about his feelings for Anjali. Ridhimma ties Armaan’s stethoscope to a wheelchair while on the lift. He loses his balance and drops curry on Dr. Shashanks coat. Later, Ridhimma apologises to Armaan for her silliness.

videos.title: Anjali to Attend a Conference
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank and Dr. Kirti decide to send Anjali to a conference in Delhi, so that she can share her experiences with the rest of her fellow members. Meanwhile, Armaan and Riddhima plan to tell everyone that they are a couple.

videos.title: Riddhima Comes In a Swim Suit
videos.overview: The boys are shocked to see the girls in the resort. To everyone's surprise, Riddhima comes in a swim suit. A game is conducted between the boys and the girls. Boys win the game. Anjali does not accept Atul's proposal. Armaan wants to surprise Riddhima, but before that she falls into danger.

videos.title: Armaan Injures Himself Critically
videos.overview: Armaan injures himself critically while trying to save Riddhima. He undergoes an operation. Doctors say that he will slip into coma, if he does not get conscious within the next 2 hours. Riddhima prays for Armaan's recovery. Will Armaan regain consciousness?

videos.title: Muskaan's Parents' Visit
videos.overview: Armaan gets better. Riddhima blames herself for his accident. Muskaan's parents come down from Punjab to take her back, and get her married. Later, Riddhima is assigned to take care of Armaan when he is shifted to the general ward. Meanwhile, Rahul speaks to Muskaan about their marriage.

videos.title: Dr. Shashank Gets Angry
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank gets angry when he sees Armaan and other patients dancing in Riddhima's presence. Muskaan tries to escape from her parents. Meanwhile, Armaan acts as if he is not keeping well. Dr. Kirti learns that he is all fine and discharges him. She asks him to report back to duty.

videos.title: Rahul and Muskaan's Marriage
videos.overview: Riddhima asks Armaan to tell her father about their love. Meanwhile, Rahul and Muskaan are surprised by their wedding. Later, Muskaan's parents also agree. Dr. Shashank congratulates them and asks them to celebrate at his home. At the party, Riddhima's father catches Armaan and Riddhima together.

videos.title: Armaan Lies to Riddhima's Father
videos.overview: Armaan lies to RIddhima's father saying that they are good friends. Later, Riddhima complains to Armaan for not telling her father the truth. They have an argument. Meanwhile, Rahul and Mushkan agree that their marriage is just a drama. However, their first wedding night is arranged at Keerti's home.

videos.title: Armaan Tries to Fulfil Promise
videos.overview: Armaan is upset with Riddhima's attitude. On the other hand, Rahul and Muskaan have an argument. At the hospital, Dr. Kirti assigns the duties to the intern doctors. Armaan tries to lift everyone's mood as promised to Riddhima. He asks Rahul to gift Muskaan a flower. He also apologises to Dr. Shashank.

videos.title: Armaan Creates Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Rahul, Muskaan and Atul have a small misunderstanding because of Armaan. They tell Dr. Kirti that they don't want to work with him. In the meantime, Dr. Kirti announces about the upcoming soccer match with Hissar Hospital. Armaan apologises to everyone, but says that he won't play the soccer match.

videos.title: Armaan does Not Play The Match
videos.overview: Riddhima leaves the decision of playing the match to Armaan. He educates his team about the strength of the opposition in the dressing room. The match starts. The opponents play aggressively and start hitting everyone. During the half time, Dr. Shashank tells everyone that they have to win the game.

videos.title: Sanjeevani Hospital Team Wins
videos.overview: Dr. Riddhima and her father, Dr. Shashank, cheer for Armaan as he decides to play the match finally. Sanjeevani hospital team wins the trophy. At the canteen, all plan for a winning party. They plan to play a prank to pick up Dr. Anjali directly from airport for the party, but get caught by Dr. Shashank.

videos.title: Dr. Shashank Warns Riddhima
videos.overview: Dr. Atul is worried as on the way their car breaks down. Dr. Shashank arrives at the same time and blames Armaan, Atul and Rahul for their deed. Dr. Riddhima blames herself for all this and confesses before Dr. Shashank, while he warns Riddhima to stay away from Armaan.

videos.title: Atul Gets Drunk
videos.overview: Armaan gets upset with Riddhima's confession. Atul worries about Anjali and asks Armaan to call Riddhima. Muskaan and Rahul have a friendly fight. Atul apologises to Anjali, but she insults him. Soon Anjali finds him missing. Atul gets drunk to express his feeling to Anjali.

videos.title: Atul Confesses His Love to Anjali
videos.overview: An intoxicated Atul creates nuisance in the hospital. Meanwhile, Dr. Kirti introduces the health inspector to everyone. Armaan, Riddhima, Muskaan and Rahul try to tackle the situation and create a good impression. Dr. Kirti thanks them for their efforts. Later, Atul comes and expresses his feelings for Anjali.

videos.title: Dr. Shashank Warns Dr. Atul
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank warns Atul to behave properly after he recovers from his hangover. Dr. Kirti punishes him by telling him to perform rectal examination for a week. Muskaan and Rahul make fun of each other. Dr. Riddhima is harassed by few guys while returning home on a rainy night. Dr. Armaan saves her.

videos.title: Confused In Love
videos.overview: Although haunted by their past, Arman and Riddhima still have love for each other. Atul is confused and his feelings for Anjali seem to be not enough as she does not give him much importance. Meanwhile, Rahul and Muskan go on with their quarrel for every small thing.

videos.title: Armaan Assures Riddhima
videos.overview: Riddhima seems confused about her love for Armaan. Anjali tells Atul that they are just friends, while he feels embarrassed. Next day, Armaan tries to express his love to Riddhima and Atul films the moment, but again things go wrong. However, Armaan assures Riddhima that they will get married.

videos.title: Rahul's Birthday Celebrations
videos.overview: The closeness between Arman and Riddhima increases. The gang plan to celebrate Rahul's birthday. However, Rahul is concerned about the money he needs to spend. Meanwhile, Arman tries to figure out ways to win a lottery, where participants should be married couples. What happens next?

videos.title: Atul Falls In a Pot Hole
videos.overview: Atul continues to try to impress Anjali. Accidently, he falls in a pot hole as he kept looking at Anjali and injures himself. Seeing this Anjali realises Atul’s feelings. Arman is worried as he learns about the prediction made on Riddhima. What is the prediction?

videos.title: Armaan Gets Into Shashank's Cabin
videos.overview: Arman tries to gather information about Dr. Shashank in his cabin. Suddenly, Dr. Shashank enters and sees Riddhima and Atul there. Both of them try their best to save Armaan. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Armaan has Nowhere to Stay
videos.overview: Armaan says he has been thrown out by his landlord, but Atul and Rahul refuse to give him accommodation. Ridhima’s grandmother learns about Armaan’s plight when she visits the hospital. She asks Armaan to come that evening with his baggage, but Dr.Shashank refuses to allow him as paying guest.

videos.title: Armaan Stays In Riddhima's House
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank's mother asks him to allow Arman to stay. Meanwhile, Armaan faints. Atul's date with Anjali ends up in an auto. The table for them is given to Rahul and Muskaan. Armaan and Ridhima's family play a game of dumbcharade. Dr.Shashank asks Armaan to make some sweet for Ganpathi pooja.

videos.title: Ganesh Puja Celebrations
videos.overview: Rahul tucks Muskaan in bed when she proposes to him. Next day, everyone prays to Ganesha and Armaan heads to make the sweet. Atul, Rahul and Muskaan visit Dr. Shashank's house for the puja. They are horrified to see vegetables around and ask Armaan about the kheer recipe.

videos.title: Armaan's Kheer Tastes Awful
videos.overview: After the meal, Armaan brings the kheer and serves it. Ridhima does not allow Dr. Shashank to have it. Everyone excuse themselves. Armaan gets to now it was awful. Next day, Armaan manages to get a lift from Dr. Shashank to Sanjeevni. Atul avoids Anjali, but she consoles him.

videos.title: Riddhima Gatecrashes In a Wedding
videos.overview: Armaan feels it is wrong to get into someone’s wedding and click pictures. But, Anjali, Riddhima, Atul and Muskaan get ready to go to the wedding. They somehow manage to enter and get photos clicked. Later, the host stops them. Armaan gets tensed when Dr. Shashank asks Riddhima about the invitation.

videos.title: Rahul-anjali's Snaps As Couple
videos.overview: Rahul and Anjali take snaps as couple along with other friends. They are indeed more shocked to learn that Dr. Shashank will attend the wedding along with Keerthi and Shubanker. Amidst the chaos and confusion, they get caught red handed by Shashank.

videos.title: Dr. Shashank Punishes The Interns
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank punishes the interns for their mistakes and mischief during the marriage ceremony. He asks them to spend the next week in Lonavala Ashram and donate their one month salary to the same Ashram. All the interns then blame Armaan for this incident. Dr. Shashank sends Armaan as well.

videos.title: The Interns Play Pranks
videos.overview: The girls find the abandoned house, where all of them were stuck for the night, very scary. They spend the night by playing pranks on each other and then fight. Dr. Shubhankar falls victim to their pranks, who comes to the house after Dr. Shashank tells him to search for the interns.

videos.title: Dr. Subhankar Becomes The Victim
videos.overview: Dr. Shubhankar is electrocuted when the girls play a prank. Then the boys decide to teach the girls a lesson. But, Dr. Shubhankar becomes the victim yet again. They have a fight, Dr. Shubhankar comes in the middle again. The road gets cleared and all of them head to Lonavala.

videos.title: All The Interns Help The Injured
videos.overview: All the interns are indulged in helping the people who were injured in the bus. Dr. Shubanker consoles Anjali as she feels sad for a kid crying on his dead mother. Rahul helps Muskaan in saving a patient's life. Armaan tries to keep Riddhima calm. Atul succeeds in helping a patient, deliver a baby.

videos.title: Armaan and Riddhima are Saved
videos.overview: Bomb disposal squad successfully defuses the bomb, and save Armaan and Riddhima. Dr. Shashank praises the interns and lifts the punishment on them. Armaan feels happy as Dr. Shashank thanks him for supporting his daughter. Armaan insists Riddhima to inform Dr. Shashank about their relationship.

videos.title: Muskaan Loses Her Camera
videos.overview: Muskaan loses her camera and is worried about this. Meanwhile, Armaan and Riddhima decide to tell Shashank about their relationship. Kirti is angry when she catches Atul reading his letter. Will Dr.Shashank accept Armaan and Riddhima?

videos.title: Armaan Gets an Invite
videos.overview: The OT work for the interns gets cancelled because Dr. Shashank is on leave. Subsequently, Dr. Keerthi asks Armaan to work for the rest of the hours and lets the interns go home. Later, Dr. Shashank catches Armaan sleeping during duty hours. How will he react?

videos.title: Armaan Goes to Singapore
videos.overview: Shashank talks to Armaan about a global conference. Armaan wants to tell Shashank about his relationship with Riddhima but cannot. He then leaves to Singapore for the  conference. Meanwhile, Kirti is angry with her juniors.

videos.title: Nikita, The New Intern
videos.overview: Nikita, the new intern, gets ragged on her first day at work. Kirti finds out about this incident and asks Nikita about it. Will Nikita tell Kirti about the interns who ragged her?

videos.title: Muskan and Rahul have a Fight
videos.overview: Muskan and Rahul have a comical fight over the wedding photos. Riddhima makes an effort to include Nikita in the group. Nikita notices Riddhima getting a bouquet. Who has sent her the bouquet?

videos.title: Riddhima's Bouquet
videos.overview: Nikita’s efforts in finding out who sent the bouquet to Riddhima go in vain. The interns are extremely keen to know who is sending  gifts to Riddhima! Will she tell them the truth?

videos.title: An Emotional Riddhima
videos.overview: Riddhima is very emotional after getting a phone call from Armaan. This convinces the interns about their relationship. Meanwhile, Anjali plots to unearth the truth by following Riddhima. Will she succeed in doing so?

videos.title: Riddhima's Birthday
videos.overview: Riddhima’s family celebrates her birthday. Meanwhile, the interns follow Riddhima and see her dancing with Armaan. What will they do with this information?

videos.title: Armaan Celebrates Ridhima's Birthday
videos.overview: Armaan sends roses for Riddhima and dances for her. He refuses to accept his love when asked. He meets Nikitai's college mate at the hotel. Armaan celebrates Ridhima's birthday. Armaan plans of telling Dr.Shashank about their love affair but he seems to have gone out of town for two days. Atul gets an oral examination for his teeth. Armaan calls Ridhima to meet him. She tells him that Anjali doubts their relation.

videos.title: Nikita As Smokescreen
videos.overview: Riddhima pleads with Nikita to keep her relationship with Armaan a secret. Nikita asks Armaan to use her as a smokescreen for his relationship with Riddhima. Armaan, however, is not convinced about this idea. Meanwhile, a large number of doctors participate in a dental care programme.

videos.title: Karva Chauth Fast For Riddhima
videos.overview: Muskan tells Anjali that Armaan and Riddhima are meeting on the terrace. However, they find Armaan and Nikita instead. Nikita and Rahul save Riddhima from Anjali when Anjali tries to break Riddhima’s karva chauth fast.

videos.title: Riddhima Asks Armaan to Wait
videos.overview: Anjali warns Armaan to be careful about Riddhima’s feelings. Armaan is the one to end Riddhima’s karva chauth fast. Riddhima, meanwhile, asks Armaan not to talk about the relationship to Shashank just yet. What is her reason for not disclosing the truth?

videos.title: Armaan and Riddhima Fight
videos.overview: There is a huge misunderstanding between Armaan and Riddhima. Nikita decides to step in to help resolve their conflict. Will she succeed in reuniting Armaan and Riddhima?

videos.title: Kirti and Sukirti
videos.overview: Kirti’s twin sister Sukirti has caused many problems in the hospital. Shubhankar scolds Kirti and she is forced to tell him the truth about her twin sister. Riddhima is angry and yells at Armaan and Anjali in the canteen.

videos.title: A Missing Document
videos.overview: Shashank elicits a promise from Riddhima not to discuss a missing document with anybody. Armaan is upset to find Riddhima in Shashank’s room. Meanwhile, Atul and Muskan meet Sangeet Pal Singh who asks them to document their lives. Anjali continues to torment Armaan with questions.

videos.title: Riddhima and Armaan Caught
