videos.overview: Riddhima convinces Armaan that she has not spoken about their relationship to Shashank. She also shocks him by stating that the hospital may be in danger of being shut down. Shashank catches Riddhima and Armaan together.

videos.title: Armaan Handles The Situation
videos.overview: Armaan manages to extricate himself when Shashank catches him red-handed with Riddhima. Shashank also lies to Riddhima about the hospital’s problems being solved. Atul stumbles upon Shubankar hugging Kirti. Will Nikita succeed in making Anjali believe that she is in a relationship with Armaan?

videos.title: Atul's Mystery Gift
videos.overview: Riddhima and Armaan manage to get some time together. Anjali, meanwhile, is astounded to see Armaan in Riddhima’s room. The pair tries to hide their relationship from her. Atul, meanwhile, gets a gift from an anonymous person.

videos.title: Armaan and Nikita
videos.overview: Rahul is enamoured by Muskan, when she wears a sari! Armaan follows a plot and acts in a particular manner with Nikita. Shashank gets some bad news.

videos.title: Shashank and Sanjivini's Future
videos.overview: Riddhima is jealous when Armaan appreciates Nikita’s looks. Shashank discusses the hospital’s economic condition with Kirti. He then decides to inform the interns about Sanjivini’s future. How will the interns deal with this news?

videos.title: Armaan Volunteers to Quit
videos.overview: Shashank tells the interns about the cost-cutting measures at Sanjivini. He also tells them that one intern will be leaving Sanjivini once the trustees have decided. Even as everybody is upset about this, Armaan volunteers to leave.

videos.title: Trustees have Decided
videos.overview: Shashank tells Armaan that the decision to fire an intern rests completely with the trustees. Shashank also gets the letter with the name of the intern who is going to be fired. Kirti talks to Shubhankar about this letter. Who is the intern who will be leaving Sanjivini?

videos.title: Abhimanyu Modi Owns Sanjivini
videos.overview: Just as Shashank is getting ready with the announcement, the new head of the hospital enters. This is Abhimanyu Modi. Kirti speaks her mind about not firing any intern. At that moment Abhimanyu says that she is the one who has been fired.

videos.title: Campaign to Bring Back Kirti
videos.overview: Abhimanyu Modi does not give in to requests of bringing back Kirti. The doctors at Sanjivini embark on a signature campaign to bring back Kirti and Shashank. Will Abhimanyu Modi succumb to their pressure?

videos.title: Abhimanyu Mocks The Doctors
videos.overview: The doctors turn up in casual outfits for their duty because they are on a non-cooperation movement. This results in a lot of confusion. Abhimanyu mocks them for their casual outfits. The doctors then decide to craft another strategy to bring back Kirti. Will they succeed now?

videos.title: Abhimanyu Talks Tough
videos.overview: The doctors start singing in the hospital premises. This infuriates Abhimanyu. He calls for a meeting and announces that even more staff will be fired. He also states that patients who have not settled bills for a long time will be sent home.

videos.title: Patients and Bills
videos.overview: Abhimanyu asks the doctors to get their patients to pay hospital bills. The doctors are so upset by this decision that they decide to pay the bills with their own money. Meanwhile, Armaan fixes a basketball game with Abhimanyu.

videos.title: Doctors Outside Sanjivini
videos.overview: Kirti joins a group of doctors who decide to serve evicted patients outside Sanjivini. This incenses Abhimanyu a lot. Will he be able to change the situation and bring the doctors back into the fold?

videos.title: Chaos At Sanjivini
videos.overview: There is a lot of confusion at Sanjivini. Doctors steal medicines from the hospital. They also perform surgery inside the hospital without Abhimanyu’s permission. Will Abhimanyu set things right for Sanjivini, the patients and doctors?

videos.title: Abhimanyu Capitulates
videos.overview: Abhimanyu catches the doctors performing the unauthorised surgery. A confrontation with Armaan leads to Abhimanyu accepting the Kirti's return. The doctors caution Abhimanyu about future consequences. Will Abhimanyu govern Sanjivini in a better manner in future?

videos.title: The Doctors In Trouble
videos.overview: At the press conference, Abhimanyu changes the game in his favour and says that the bills of the patient will be cleared by the doctors, and also praises Armaan for his efforts. How will the doctors tackle this situation?

videos.title: Doctors Put Up a Show
videos.overview: The doctors struggle to arrange the money, and seek the help of a mafia don, who confuses them for drama artistes. He threatens them to enact Sholay. The doctors try convincing the don that they are not the artistes, but he refuses to listen.

videos.title: The Don is Angry With The Docs
videos.overview: On watching the gloomy performance, the don gets furious and fires his gun in the air. He blasts the doctors for insulting the movie characters and film makers. The interns manage to escape the don’s grasp. Later, Armaan plans to take part in a motor bike race. Will he win?

videos.title: Armaan Meets With an Accident
videos.overview: Armaan meets with an accident during the race, and is rushed to the hospital. On regaining consciousness, his friends scold him for participating in the race. The doctors now decide to hold a concert to raise funds.

videos.title: Armaan Challenges Abhimanyu
videos.overview: Armaan is disappointed when everyone pushes Abhimanyu to couple with Riddhima. Dr Shashank instructs Armaan to take care of himself. When Abhimanyu refuses to dance, Armaan challenges him and walks out of his cabin. Will Abhimanyu support the doctors’ cause?

videos.title: Abhimanyu Joins Hands
videos.overview: The doctors gear up for the practice and Abhimanyu’s entry surprises everyone. He joins the performance, and makes everyone dance to his tunes. Riddhima tells Armaan that she feels awkward dancing with Abhimanyu. How will Armaan react to this?

videos.title: Riddhima Feels Uncomfortable
videos.overview: Riddhima feels uncomfortable when Abhimanyu tries to create a chemistry with her. When Armaan interrupts the practice, Abhimanyu gets offended, and decides to quit. Meanwhile, Shubankar panics as his daughter goes missing.

videos.title: Armaan Apologises to Abhimanyu
videos.overview: Armaan apologises to Abhimanyu and convinces him to be a part of the concert. Atul is so stressed about the dance that he starts daydreaming. Later, Armaan gets tensed on seeing Riddhima and Abhimanyu dance. Will he act on it?

videos.title: Abhimanyu is Annoyed
videos.overview: Armaan expresses his concern for Riddhima, while Shubankar and Nikita try expressing their feelings to each other. Later, Abhimanyu gets annoyed over Riddhima’s reaction during the dance performance. What will he do?

videos.title: Muskaan Shares Rahul's Pain
videos.overview: Rahul is upset over his dad’s illness, and Muskaan shares his pain. Armaan learns about Abhimanyu’s absence, and tries entertaining the guests with a song. The directors meanwhile, inform Riddhima that her dance performance is essential.

videos.title: Abhimanyu Performs With Riddhima
videos.overview: Armaan thanks Nikki for her support during the concert. Abhimanyu returns, and dances with Riddhima. Meanwhile, Nikki is upset on seeing Armaan and Riddhima together. On the other hand, Shubankar once again fails to express his feelings to Kirti.

videos.title: Muskaan is Disappointed
videos.overview: The doctors are extremely happy about the success of their concert, but their joy is short-lived. Abhimanyu makes them aware that the problems still persist. Meanwhile, Muskaan is disappointed on learning that Rahul is leaving. Will she express her feelings to him now?

videos.title: Armaan Expresses His Love
videos.overview: Nikita sees herself as a barrier between Armaan and Riddhima, and expresses her wish to leave Sanjeevani, which Abhimanyu refuses. Meanwhile, the doctors are unhappy about Rahul’s departure. Later, Armaan expresses his love for Riddhima, and plans a big surprise for the New Year party.

videos.title: Abhimanyu Advises Riddhima
videos.overview: Muskaan plans to accompany Rahul to his home. Meanwhile, Riddhima expresses her love to Armaan, and everyone enjoys the New Year Party. Abhimanyu advises Riddhima to listen to her heart, and not to what others say.

videos.title: Armaan's Surprise For Riddhima
videos.overview: In the evening, all the interns plan to dance with their partners. Muskaan and Rahul enjoy the party, while Armaan plans to present his surprise to Riddhima. He takes Riddhima out of the party, and asks her to open her eyes to see his surprise.

videos.title: Shubhankar Proposes to Kirti
videos.overview: Riddhima is happy with Armaan’s surprise. Meanwhile, Shubhankar proposes to Kirti. She accepts his proposal, but expects Navneeta’s acceptance. Later, Rahul advises Armaan to confess his love for Riddhima in front of everyone.

videos.title: Muskaan Misses Rahul
videos.overview: Armaan plans to follow Rahul’s advice, and plans to please Shashank. Meanwhile, Nikita traps Abhimanyu to do a rectal test. On the other hand, Muskaan misses Rahul, and is disappointed to see his goodbye letter.

videos.title: Muskaan is Heartbroken
videos.overview: Muskaan is heartbroken after Rahul leaves. While Dr Shubankar decides to disclose his love for Kirti in front of his daughter, Abhimanyu changes his views about Riddhima and starts to like her. How will Riddhima react to the change in Abhimanyu’s behaviour?

videos.title: Riddhima Angry With Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima is angry as Armaan tries to impress his future father-in-law, and does not give her sufficient time. Armaan tries convincing her and puts a letter in her file, which she does not notice. Later, he finally finds a way to impress Dr Shashank. What will he do?

videos.title: Armaan's Letter With Shubhankar
videos.overview: Armaan learns that the letter that he had written for Riddhima has reached Shashank’s cabin by mistake. He rushes to the cabin, and finds Shubhankar reading the letter. Shubhankar then asks him to pass it to Riddhima, and assumes the writer is Atul. Will Armaan tell him the truth?

videos.title: Armaan Leaves For Lonavala
videos.overview: Armaan leaves for Lonavala with Shubankar, and Atul plans to go with the other interns. Armaan tries to stop them by damaging their car indicators. The car stops on the way, and they fail to reach Lonavala.

videos.title: Riddhima Still Angry With Armaan
videos.overview: Dr Shubankar tells Dr Shashank about Atul. Riddhima is still angry with Armaan, even as the latter tries to convince her. Riddhima feels that he is not serious about their love.

videos.title: Shubankar Decides to Help Armaan
videos.overview: Dr Shubankar offers to help Armaan after listening to his love story. Armaan decides to speak to Dr Shashank about Atul, and learns that Dr Shashank does not like him. Later, Dr Shashank tells Armaan about the qualities that his son-in-law should possess.

videos.title: Armaan's New Look
videos.overview: Dr Shubankar helps Armaan get a new look to become an ideal son-in-law. His new look is so different that everyone refuses to recognise him. Riddhima also fails to recognise him. Will Dr Shashank be pleased with his new look?

videos.title: Armaan Upset On People's Reaction
videos.overview: Armaan’s new look doesn’t seem to impress Dr Shashank, as he passes comments against it. Armaan is hurt with his remarks. The patients and Dr Abhimanyu make fun of Armaan, while Dr Nikita consoles him. She plans to teach Dr Abhimanyu a lesson. What will she do?

videos.title: Foreign Delegates Disappointed
videos.overview: Armaan worries on learning that the doctors have inhaled laughing gas, while the foreign delegates are disappointed. The foreign delegates agree to fund Sanjeevani, and in return, they expect them to treat a patient.

videos.title: Armaan Impresses Everyone
videos.overview: As per the deal made with the delegates, Armaan decides to treat some patients. He impresses everyone with his treatment. Dr Kirti requests him to help Dr Shashank in an important case. Will Armaan agree?

videos.title: Armaan Tries Helping Dhruv
videos.overview: Armaan meets his new patient Dhruv, and tries to help him. Dr Shashank informs Riddhima that he would like to spend some time with her. She invites Armaan to join them, as she plans to reveal their relationship.

videos.title: Abhimanyu is Furious
videos.overview: Armaan and Nikita dress up as angels and try to make Dhruv laugh. However, Dr Abhimanyu fumes on seeing the doctors dancing, and gives Armaan a piece of his mind. Meanwhile, Riddhima is upset, as Armaan doesn’t turn up.

videos.title: Armaan Takes Riddhima On a Date
videos.overview: Armaan asks Riddhima out on a date. Meanwhile, Dr Shashank spots them together and mistakes Armaan for Atul and thinks that he is asking Riddhima out. Later, he tells Anjali to keep an eye on Riddhima. Later, Riddhima goes on a date with Armaan.

videos.title: Armaan and Riddhima Get Arrested
videos.overview: Armaan and Riddhima are on a date. When Shashank learns that Riddhima and Armaan are not present in the hospital, he gets worried. Meanwhile, Armaan and Riddhima get arrested for making love in public. Shashank rushes to the police station and brings Riddhima back home.

videos.title: Riddhima Pleads For Armaan
videos.overview: Dr. Shashank tells Armaan to leave. Riddhima pleads for him and requests Dr. Shashank to give him a chance. Armaan is ready to do whatever it takes to speak to him. He relentlessly stands in the rain.

videos.title: Riddhima Takes Sick Leave
videos.overview: Riddhima lies that she is sick and takes leave. Dr Kirti advises the interns to not let personal problems affect their career. Later, she assigns Armaan’s duty to OPD in the next building and changes his working hours. Armaan tries to talk to Riddhima, but in vain.

videos.title: Riddhima Goes to Armaan's House
videos.overview: Riddhima skips hospital and goes to meet Armaan. Dr. Shashank looks for her. Armaan tries to pacify her and asks her to be patient. Atul, Nikita and Muskaan go to Armaan’s place. Dr. Shashank also arrives there. He rebukes Armaan and tells him that he broke his trust.

videos.title: Armaan Challenges Shashank
videos.overview: Armaan challenges Shashank that he cannot take Riddhima away from him. Shashank accepts his challenge. Meanwhile, Armaan invites Riddhima for lunch through a patient.

videos.title: Armaan Puts Up a Tent
videos.overview: Riddhima waits for Armaan in the cafeteria. Armaan requests Kirti for a 15-minute break, but she refuses. When Armaan does not show up, Riddhima leaves. The next day, Armaan puts up a tent in front of Riddhima’s house. How will Shashank react to it?

videos.title: Police Warn Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima tries to convince Shashank about Armaan. BMC personnel instruct Armaan to remove his tent, but he convinces them to let it stay. Shashank calls the police to remove the tent by 6 p.m. or he’ll have to face serious consequences.

videos.title: Shashank is Furious At Armaan
videos.overview: Armaan sees that the staff, patients and police have gathered in front of his tent. Shashank is furious, as Armaan has led to affect his reputation. Atul and gang plan to seek an RJ's help in resolving this fight. The RJ manages to get Shashank and Armaan speak on a debate over a radio show.

videos.title: Shashank and Armaan Debate
videos.overview: Shashank agrees to participate in the debate. A large crowd gathers outside his house. While Armaan puts across his love for Riddhima. Shashank calls him a cheat, who has cheated Riddhima and his friends as well.

videos.title: Armaan Loses The Debate
videos.overview: Armaan admits his mistakes while debating with Shashank. All his supporters leave. However, he promises Shashank that as long as his love is with him, he will not go anywhere. To this, Shashank says that he will ensure Riddhima’s window is closed for him. Armaan waits for her to open the window.

videos.title: Armaan Gets Into a Fight
videos.overview: Armaan sends a message to Riddhima through the radio show. He asks her to open the window before the song gets over. A few untoward men come and mock his love. They even touch Riddhima. Armaan gets furious and hits them. Police arrive and arrest them along with Armaan.

videos.title: Media Comes to Cover The Incident
videos.overview: Media arrives to cover the whole incident. Armaan lies to them to get rid of them. However, Nana reveals to them about his hunger strike. Riddhima has also not eaten anything because Armaan has been starving himself. When Nikita gets food for him, Anjali thinks that he is faking the strike.

videos.title: Armaan Continues to Stay Hungry
videos.overview: Anjali decides to expose Armaan. She tries finding proofs against him. Nikita and other friends insist him to eat, but he does not give up. He does not eat until he gets to speak to Riddhima. Finally, she speaks to him, but only to tell that he cannot meet her ever again.

videos.title: Armaan Becomes Unconscious
videos.overview: Armaan becomes unconscious due to fasting since three days. Anjali realises that her opinion about him was wrong. Riddhima is worried about his health. Shashank’s family tries to make him believe that Armaan has true feelings for Riddhima.

videos.title: Armaan and Riddhima Valentine's Day Party Plans
videos.overview: Armaan wishes Riddhima on the eve of Valentine’s Day. He plans to throw a party the next day and invites all the friends. Everyone arrives at the party, but Armaan is nowhere to be found. Riddhima becomes worried. Why is Armaan missing from his own party? Watch the romantic Valentine's day episode of Dill Mill Gayye, only on Hotstar.

videos.title: Rahul Shows Up
videos.overview: Armaan and Riddhima immerse themselves in each other’s love.  They perform a salsa dance. Everyone dresses up in Halloween costumes. To everyone’s surprise, Rahul appears at the party. He shows up for Muskaan, but she warns him to stay away.

videos.title: Nikita Mixes Drug In Drink
videos.overview: Nikita mixes up a drug in a drink and intoxicates Abhimanyu. He tells Navnitha that he has decided to marry Nikita. Shashank finds out about Nikita’s plan to insult Abhimanyu. While everyone else is enjoying the party, suddenly Dhruv becomes unconscious.

videos.title: Dhruv is Hospitalised
videos.overview: Dhruv is hospitalised. The doctors are unable to diagnose his ailment. However, Armaan and Riddhima find out that he is suffering from a hereditary disease. Abhimanyu walks aimlessly on the streets under the influence of a drink. Nikita records him acting crazy on her mobile.

videos.title: Nikita Spreads Abhimanyu's Mms
videos.overview: Rahul and Muskaan spend time together and clear their misunderstandings. Dhruv recovers. Nikita spreads Abhimanyu's MMS that she had recorded. He becomes furious at her. However, she accuses him of misbehaving. Shashank asks Armaan to bring his father to discuss the betrothal.

videos.title: Armaan Plans to Reveal The Truth
videos.overview: Shashank invites Armaan and his father to join for lunch. Armaan reluctantly agrees. Rahul and Muskaan share about the night that they spent together with other friends . Armaan decides to reveal the truth to Shashank. Will it ruin Armaan’s impression in Shashank’s eyes?

videos.title: Billy Meets Shashank
videos.overview: Armaan goes to Shashank’s house to disclose his relationship with his dad. To his surprise, his dad, Billi is already there. He finds out that Nikita has been behind it. He wants to confront her, but rest of the gang arrives and interrupts him.

videos.title: Muskaan Confronts Rahul
videos.overview: Rahul tells Muskaan that he came back from the U.S. because he loves her. Muskaan hears all his justifications and seeks a commitment, this time. The rest of the gang eavesdrop their conversation from the next room. Armaan recalls how he had suffered because of his parents’ differences.

videos.title: Holi Party At Shashank's House
videos.overview: Kirti announces that Shashank is hosting a Holi party in his house and that no drugs will be allowed. She particularly warns Atul and Armaan against it. However, Hetal brings sweets with bhang in it. Atul and Billie eat those and become high.

videos.title: Nikita Forced to Drink Bhaang
videos.overview: Armaan's father forces Nikita to drink bhaang. Later, he throws colour at his mother and she gets angry. While Armaan tries to handle his father, Muskaan gets drunk and picks up a fight with Rahul.

videos.title: Armaan Criticises His Parents
videos.overview: Bili makes Dr Shashank drink bhaang. Under the influence, Bili talks about his relationship with Ananya. However, Dr Shashank is sleepy and he doesn’t listen to him. Armaan holds his parents responsible for the incident and criticises them.

videos.title: Abhimanyu Takes Nikita Home
videos.overview: Atul and Armaan sneak into Anjali’s room to apologise to her. Abhimanyu takes Nikita to his house. She shares with him her loneliness, under the influence of bhang.  Billi invites Shashank’s family for dinner at his house.

videos.title: Shashank is Locked
videos.overview: Armaan invites all his friends to the dinner. He asks them to keep Billi away from Ananya when Dr. Shashank is around. Meanwhile, Billi locks Shashank in a room by mistake, but is unable to unlock the door. How will Armaan handle this situation?

videos.title: Engagement Date is Finalised
videos.overview: Armaan helps Dr. Shashank to get out of the room. Meanwhile, Anjali gets ready to go out on a date with Atul. Shshank finally sits with Billi to finalise a date for Armaan and Riddhima's engagement. The next day, Sangeet returns to Sanjeevani, to everyone’s surprise.

videos.title: Armaan is Stressed About Panchgani
videos.overview: Armaan is anxious about keeping the truth about his parent’s marriage from Shashank in Panchgani. Muskaan tries to make Rahul jealous by calling Sangeet. Meanwhile, Nikita tricks Abhimanyu to fall into a pit. Later, Shubhankar is disheartened as Kirti returns the ring to him.

videos.title: Atul Messes Up His Date With Anjali
videos.overview: Atul spoils his date with Anjali and calls Rahul for help. Abhimanyu and Nikita are lost in a jungle on their way to a village. Atul tries hard to impress Anjali on Rahul’s advice, but Anjali does not look amused. Will Atul lose this chance to woo her?

videos.title: Rahul Wants to Confront Sangeet
videos.overview: Rahul decides to confront Sangeet. There, Atul makes his date even worse in attempts to impress Anjali. She leaves the restaurant. Armaan tries to talk Kirti with Navnita and Dhruv. He tells them that Dr. Keerti will prove to be a great mother. Will Abhimabyu and Nikita reach the village?

videos.title: Families Reach Panchgani
videos.overview: Abhimanyu and Nikita play pranks on each other. They appear to enjoy each other’s company. Armaan is trying hard to hide the rift between his parents from Shashank. Both the families reach Panchgani for the engagement. Armaan learns about a film shooting in the farmhouse. What is his next move?

videos.title: Billi Welcomes Shashank's Family
videos.overview: Billi welcomes Shashank’s family in Panchgani. Atul and Rahul are positioned to hide Sukeerti from Shashank. Seeing them behaving awkward, Padma thinks that Atul might be a gay. Nikita reaches Panchgani. She is baffled because she finds out that her parents are getting divorced.

videos.title: Nikita Finds Out About Divorce
videos.overview: Shashank questions Nikita about her parents and about the papers sent to Armaan’s house. Nikita, Armaan and Billi manage to cover the issue. Billi offers free advice to Rahul and Atul on how to attract women. He gives them a perfume.

videos.title: Shubhanker Proposes to Keerti
videos.overview: Navnitha and Dhruv convince Kirti and Shubhankar to go on a date. Shubhankar proposes to Keerti, and she accepts. Shashank suspects that something is wrong between Billi and Ananya. He stays up in the night to know about their relationship.

videos.title: The Kabaddi Match
videos.overview: Shashank continues to spy on Billi and Ananya. On the other side, the kabaddi match between the boys and girls begins, and Shashank becomes a referee. Billi and Ananya also join them. There is a race among boys for who should attack the girls first.

videos.title: Shashank Follows Riddhima
videos.overview: The girls win the kabaddi match. Shashank sees Riddhima going towards the farmhouse, and follows her. Armaan bribes a man to hide the fact that Billi owns that farmhouse. Shubhankar and Kirti announce their decision to get married. Will Shashank find out anything?

videos.title: Boys and Girls Play Kabaddi
videos.overview: Boys and girls ague over Shubhankar and Kirti’s wedding preparations. To settle the matter they decide to challenge each other over a game of 'Truth and Dare'. Sukeerti lures Billy to get the video camera from Shashank’s room. Will Shashank find out that his camera is missing?

videos.title: Boys Face Crazy Challenges
videos.overview: The boys challenge Anjali to date Atul for a week. Nikita dares Rahul to act like a dog or tell the truth. He confesses about his love. Nikita then gives a crazy challenge to Abhimanyu. Suddenly, a noise wakes up the women in the house.

videos.title: Armaan's Parents Put On an Act
videos.overview: Armaan is looking for Riddhima, but she is nowhere to be seen. He is surprised to see Billy offering prayers in the morning. Padma advises Shashank that it is wrong to spy on another person.

videos.title: Armaan Talks to His Mother
videos.overview: Armaan talks to his mother Annie about her divorce. She says that it is a way out of the constant fights and that they can no longer live together. Armaan decides to tell Dr Shashank that his parents are headed for a divorce. Meanwhile, Rahul understands Muskaan’s feelings for him.

videos.title: Padma's Engagement Preparations
videos.overview: Abhimanyu wants to talk to Riddhima in private, but she ignores him. Armaan figures out a way to tell Riddhima about his problem. Dr Shashank and Padma make preparations for their engagement. Armaan tells everyone that the divorce papers that Shashank saw were of his parents.

videos.title: Riddhima and Armaan Get Engaged
videos.overview: Armaan walks out after telling about his parents and the farm house. Riddhima runs and hugs him. Although Dr Shashank says that he has had his doubts all along, he proudly accepts Armaan as his son-in-law. Riddhima and Armaan get engaged informally.

videos.title: Atul Seeks Modi's Help
videos.overview: Atul asks for Dr Modi’s help to stay with Anjali for a week. Atul gifts chocolates to Nikita to convince her to go to New Bombay with Dr Modi. Armaan tells Riddhima that Dr Shashank had kept a camera to record his parents’ fights.

videos.title: Riddhima Fights With Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima gets angry when Armaan tells her that Dr Shashank has planted a camera in his parents’ room. After a while, they bump into each other in the locker room and get into another argument. Meanwhile, love is in the air for Rahul and Muskaan.

videos.title: Atul Expresses Love to Anjali
videos.overview: Kirti assigns work to all the interns. Nikita and Muskaan plan to play a prank on her. Armaan and Riddhima are immersed into each other’s eyes. Atul expresses his feelings to Anjali. Will Anjali accept his love or leave him heartbroken?

videos.title: Modi Takes Nikita Out On a Date
videos.overview: Armaan believes Riddhima hasn’t read the letter and tears it off thinking it’s the one, which he sent her. Later, they both fight over the removal of Nana’s plaster. Modi takes Nikita out on a date and the couple meet Mr Patil. Later, a misunderstanding crops up between them because of Mr Patil.

videos.title: Kirti and Shubhankar’s Wedding
videos.overview: Anjali reminds Atul that only a day is left for their date and seeks Shashank’s permission for the same. Meanwhile, the interns decide to plan Kirti and Shubhankar's wedding. Riddhima and Armaan discuss about the wedding. Meanwhile, Modi tries to clear the misunderstandings with Nikita.

videos.title: Armaan's Lost Apology Card Found
videos.overview: Riddhima finds the lost apology card that Armaan had given. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu wants to take Nikita for the Mumbai project as he thinks she is better than other interns, and could be beneficial for the project. Armaan and his friends protest against Abhimanyu for being partial.

videos.title: The Boxing Championship
videos.overview: Nikita asks Riddhima to solve the problem between Armaan and Abhimanyu. Abhimanyu decides to have a boxing championship. Nikita will stay if Armaan wins and if he loses, Abhimanyu will take her to Mumbai.

videos.title: Nikita Agrees to do The Project
videos.overview: Abhimanyu asks Nikita if she has any apprehensions about his decision to fight Armaan. Nikita agrees to do the Navi Mumbai project, but requests him not to fight with Armaan. Will she be able to convince him?

videos.title: Armaan and Abhimanyu Fight
videos.overview: Armaan and Dr Abhimanyu engage in a brawl even as Nikita tries to stop them. Nikita calls up Riddhima and asks her help to avoid the fight. Meanwhile, Dr Abhimanyu punches Armaan and he falls down.

videos.title: Armaan's Assumption
videos.overview: Armaan assumes Riddhima has not read the letter and tears the same thinking it is the one which he sent her. The duo argue over the removal of Nana’s plaster. Meanwhile, Shashank and Armaan discuss the latter’s engagement date. Elsewhere, a misunderstanding crops up between Nikita and Modi.

videos.title: Armaan Blames Riddhima
videos.overview: Abhimanyu thinks that he has won the fight. Meanwhile, Armaan blames Riddhima for getting hit by Abhimanyu and differences crop up between them. The next day, when everyone asks Armaan about his wounds, Atul comes up with an explanation.

videos.title: Riddhima Selected For The Project
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked at Abhimanyu's announcement of Riddhima’s name for the project. Armaan questions Riddhima for accepting the project. She replies she is just doing her job.

videos.title: Armaan is Insecure
videos.overview: Armaan manages to convince Riddhima to see him once. He takes her to his house, where he insists that she refuse the project with Abhimanyu. However, Riddhima feels his apprehensions are out of place and that she is responsible at work.

videos.title: Armaan is Mad With Abhimanyu
videos.overview: Riddhima asks Armaan to keep their personal relationship away from their professional one. At the same time, Abhimanyu calls up Riddhima and asks her to take the project seriously. Later, he takes Riddhima with him for a presentation.

videos.title: Armaan Meets a Girl
videos.overview: Riddhima tells Abhimanyu that she doesn’t want to attend the presentation. Meanwhile, Armaan meets a girl at a pub. Nikita calls up Riddhima and tells her that Abhimanyu has left his presentation file behind.

videos.title: Nikita Brings The Old Records
videos.overview: Nikita brings the old Sanjeevani records to the presentation, but Abhimanyu tells her that the committee expressed its contempt on him. Meanwhile, Armaan saves Pari from goons and tells her about his fight with Ridhima. Later, Ridhima finds Armaan and Pari in a pub.

videos.title: Armaan Calls Riddhima
videos.overview: Armaan calls Ridhima since Pari is unconscious, but her mobile is with Dr. Abhimanyu. Riddhima is not convinced by Armaan’s explanation on Pari’s presence in his house. In the meantime, Nikita vows to Abhimanyu that she will bag the project from Dr. Patil.

videos.title: Riddhima Prevents Armaan’s Dance
videos.overview: At the Sangeet, Riddhima tells Armaan not to dance when Pari asks him to do so. Later, Shubhaankar's sister Pari approaches Armaan and asks him why he did not call her. Meanwhile, Nikita is scared due to some sound while rehearsing for the presentation and hugs Modi.

videos.title: Abhimanyu Assists Nikita
videos.overview: Abhimanyu assists a stressed Nikita to prepare for the presentation.  Meanwhile, at the wedding, some men come disguised as police and dance. Later, police raid the party and arrest the women. How does Nikita try convincing the minister at the presentation?

videos.title: Nikita Requests Officials to Grant Permission For New Hospital
videos.overview: In today's episode, cops arrested the strippers who came in the outfit of cops in Keerti's song ceremony. Government officials are not impressed by the presentation of Nikita and denies to grant permission for the new hospital. Armaan refuses to accept that he has sent the strippers and request to spare the lady doctors. Later Dr. Abhimanyu makes the officials understand the whole project and makes them grant it. Armaan's lie is caught by Ridhima later and she sees him giving ring to Babli.

videos.title: Armaan Misleads Riddhima
videos.overview: Armaan attempts to mislead Riddhima over the ring, but later admits that Dr. Shubankar selected the ring for Kirti. Later, Nikita hears Abhimanyu talking about shares and presumes that he wants to take all the credit for himself.  Does Armaan manage to convince Riddhima?

videos.title: Abhimanyu Makes The Announcement
videos.overview: During the party, Abhimanyu reveals that they have acquired the Sanjeevani Project and bestows all the credit to Nikita. Therefore, Nikita wishes to apologise to Abhimanyu. Meanwhile, Muskan confronts Rahul for avoiding her. Further, the lady doctors refuse to dance with the men.

videos.title: The Ladies Challenge The Men
videos.overview: The lady doctors dare the guys for a dance competition. Later, Kirti refuses to dance with Shubankar since she is not too keen to dance with the guys. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu approaches Nikita to dance with him.

videos.title: Shubankar Proposes to Kirti
videos.overview: At the party, Shubankar proposes to Kirti, but she is stressed at the thought of marriage. Meanwhile, Nikita arrives after Abhimanyu leaves. Kirti is grateful to Riddhima for convincing her about Shubankar’s relevance. Later, Kirti watches a horrifying news on TV.

videos.title: Armaan Congratulates Riddhima
videos.overview: Armaan congratulates Riddhima for managing the imaginary wedding. Later, the ward boy tells Abhimanyu about the upcoming curfew near the hospital. Meanwhile, Riddhima is irritated when Armaan tries to convince Shubankar to present the old ring.

videos.title: The Mob Breaks Into a Riot
videos.overview: Riots break out when the party leader is arrested. Later, the mob attacks Nikita when she goes in search of Abhimanyu. Meanwhile, everyone opposes Riddhima’s view that Shubankar and Kirti’s wedding should be held as scheduled.

videos.title: Goons Attack Nikita
videos.overview: In the curfew, the goons attack Nikita. Later, Abhimanyu fights with the goons and rescues her. Meanwhile, Riddhima gets furious at Armaan when she sees Pari and gets irritated with him. What does Riddhima do?

videos.title: Abhimanyu Saves Nikita
videos.overview: Abhimanyu and Nikita bond after he hits the goons and saves her. Atul gets a call from the priest saying that he is going back because of the riot. Everyone brainstorms on how to continue with the wedding. Shubankar picks up Dr. Kirti in an ambulance.

videos.title: Armaan Warns Dr. Abhimanyu Modi
videos.overview: Armaan warns Dr. Abhimanyu Modi to stay away from Nikita. Shubankar arrives with Kirti before both of them into a fight. Dr. Kirti invites Abhimanyu for the wedding. Everyone gets ready to make the necessary arrangements. Everyone tries to arrange a priest for the wedding but none of them are ready to come. They narrow down on the names of people. Riddhima and Modi start cooking but he is in a trance. Armaan informs Muskaan about them. Riddhima finally gets Abhimanyu to accept the fact that he loves Nikita. She promises to send Nikita near the pool side.

videos.title: Nikita Goes to The Poolside
videos.overview: Riddhima convinces Nikita to go near the poolside, but Armaan intercepts her. Meanwhile, Muskaan tells Armaan that Abhimanyu is troubling Nikita. Later, at the poolside, Armaan and Abhimanyu get into a dispute.

videos.title: Nikita and Abhimanyu are Upset
videos.overview: While Nikita is upset that Abhimanyu did not defend her, he is offended that she did not take his side in front of her friends. Meanwhile, Riddhima reveals to Armaan that Nikita loves Abhimanyu. How does Armaan react to Riddhima’s words?

videos.title: Shubankar and Kirti’s Marriage
videos.overview: Atul manages to conduct Shubankar and Kirti's wedding. In the meantime, Abhimanyu plans to take revenge on Armaan as well as Nikita because of the humiliation that he faced. How does he plan his revenge?

videos.title: Pari Mentions The Ring
videos.overview: Armaan manages to change the topic when Pari speaks about the ring. Later, when the ring ceremony is underway, Riddhima questions him for lying that the ring belonged to Shubankar. What answer does Armaan give Riddhima?

videos.title: Armaan Lies to Riddhima
videos.overview: Armaan evasively tells Riddhima that Shubankar chose the ring for Kirti. Riddhima expresses her regret for suspecting him. Meanwhile, Nikita is distraught when Abhimanyu humiliates her and throws her out.

videos.title: The Dark Side Of Abhimanyu
videos.overview: Riddhima wants Armaan to avoid any friction with Abhimanyu. Abhimanyu's insult still disturbs Nikita. Will someone be able to make him see reason?

videos.title: Riddhima Overhears a Conversation
videos.overview: Armaan assures Riddhima that he will not speak against Dr Abhimanyu. Meanwhile, Nikita decides to work with Abhimanyu. Riddhima overhears Pari and Armaan's conversation.

videos.title: Riddhima is Upset With Armaan
videos.overview: Speculation over Pari and Armaan spending a night together upsets Riddhima. She turns a deaf ear to Armaan’s clarifications. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu continues to make life difficult for Nikita. What will Nikita do?

videos.title: Abhimanyu Insults Nikita
videos.overview: Dr Abhimanyu talks about changes for Sanjeevani, but Armaan wants them to be free of personal bias. However, Abhimanyu sticks to his guns. Nikita is again at the receiving end of his insults.

videos.title: Abhimanyu has His Suspicions
videos.overview: Nikita still carries the burden of Armaan’s insults. Armaan sends a message to Riddhima, and a suspicious Abhimanyu follows them. Will they get away from his prying eyes?

videos.title: Dr Atul Comes to Anjali's House
videos.overview: Armaan rues that Riddhima still misunderstands him. Abhimanyu invites Nikki home. Atul, in his bid to find out about his secret admirer, reaches Anjali's house. Dr Shashank's presence at the house complicates the issue. How will Atul get out of the situation?

videos.title: Riddhima Agrees to Get Married
videos.overview: Riddhima says 'yes' to marriage, and Armaan and the staff are elated. Atul expresses his love for Anjali. Is there a surprise in store for Abhimanyu?

videos.title: Armaan is Happy and Thrilled
videos.overview: Atul congratulates a thrilled, to-be-married, Armaan. He is equally happy to find Anjali to be his secret admirer. Dr Sumanlata is the new entrant in Sanjeevani. Her entry rattles Abhimanyu. Why?

videos.title: Dr Dalmia Reveals Her Feelings
videos.overview: While Dr Suman Dalmia reports to Dr Nikita, she directs her attention at Dr Abhimanyu. Armaan indulges Riddhima's family, to irk her. Later, Suman expresses her feelings to Abhimanyu.

videos.title: Armaan Brings a Gift
videos.overview: Riddhima thwarts Armaan's effort in bringing up the discussion on marriage with Dr Shashank. Meanwhile, Anjali causes Atul to lose his voice. Later, Armaan impresses upon Anjali to convince Shashank. Meanwhile, Suman seeks Nikki's help to woo Abhimanyu.

videos.title: Anjali Delivers a Shock
videos.overview: Nikita, in a revenge mode, encourages Suman to woo Abhimanyu. Suman dances for Abhimanyu in his cabin. Anjali delivers a shocker to Armaan. Will Armaan recover?

videos.title: Dr Anjali is Upset
videos.overview: Anjali is upset about marrying early, to pave the way for Riddhima. Atul goes incognito to change Anjali's mind. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu catches Nikki reading Suman's files.

videos.title: Armaan Meets With an Accident
videos.overview: Armaan and Riddhima recollect the good times. Anjali is happy about her wedding plans being cancelled. Meanwhile, both Abhimanyu and Nikki dislike Suman's ways of wooing Abhimanyu. Later, Armaan meets with an accident.

videos.title: Armaan has an Accident
videos.overview: Armaan recalls his moments with Riddhima. Riddhima goes in search of him again. Anjali expresses her happiness to Atul as plans of her wedding are cancelled. Armaan leaves his house before Riddhima reaches, but meets with an accident. Riddhima feels she has made a mistake.

videos.title: Riddhima Worries About Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima gets worried about Armaan's disappearance. She hopes for him to be healthy and safe. Dr Nikki accidentally falls down the stairs and gets hurt. Dr Abhimanyu rushes to her care. Riddhima feels happy to see Dr Abhimanyu's concern and love for Dr Nikki.

videos.title: Armaan is Injured
videos.overview: Without knowing it is Armaan, Riddhima treats a badly-injured Armaan. Meanwhile, Armaan's bag causes a bomb scare at the hospital. Muskaan comes to know about Rahul deliberately avoiding her.

videos.title: Armaan is In a Wheelchair
videos.overview: Abhimanyu sends a note to Nikita triggering off old memories. Later, the sight of a wheelchair-borne Armaan shocks everyone.

videos.title: Dr Shashank is Shocked
videos.overview: In a role reversal, Abhimanyu wants Suman to take care of Nikita. Armaan's changed attitude shocks everyone. Abhimanyu reveals the real reason behind it. What could it be?

videos.title: Armaan's Memory Loss
videos.overview: Dr Shashank describes Armaan's medical condition as a cause of memory loss. Nikita and Abhimanyu have a fight, while Riddhima is unable to reconcile with Armaan's medical condition.

videos.title: Armaan Flirts With Anjali
videos.overview: Armaan flirts with Anjali, infuriating Riddhima. Meanwhile, Suman wants to have lunch with Abhimanyu. Later, he cooks for Nikki. Armaan finds a new girl to flirt with!

videos.title: Abhimanyu Helps Nikki to Cook
videos.overview: Abhimanyu and Nikita romance in the kitchen. But, Sumati irritates the couple during lunch. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu and Riddhima discuss an emergency. Later, Nikkita mixes a tablet in Sumati's drink.

videos.title: Riddhima Gets a Shock
videos.overview: Siddhant drinks the spiked juice meant for Sumati. Meanwhile, Armaan falls in love with Riddhima again. Later, Riddhima sees Armaan's scan report. What will she find?

videos.title: Riddhima Goes Down Memory Lane
videos.overview: Armaan's partial amnesia shocks Riddhima who is unable to come to terms with it. She recalls her memories with him. Meanwhile, Sumati prepares juice for Siddhant.

videos.title: Siddhant and Nikki are In Love
videos.overview: Siddhant and Nikki are attracted to each other. Riddhima shares her frustration with Anjali, Atul and Muskaan. Atul forces his friendship on Armaan, and has a fight with Anjali. Meanwhile, Armaan is keen to stay back at Nikki's place.

videos.title: Muskaan Reminisces About Armaan.
videos.overview: Abhimanyu wishes to know about Nikki's true feelings for him. Meanwhile, Muskaan reminisces about Armaan. Later, Suman insists Siddhant and Nikki accompany her to a party.

videos.title: Riddhima-armaan Get Up and Close
videos.overview: Sparks fly between Riddhima and Armaan. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu plans to visit Jaipur for a project. Later, the new duty-roster prepared by Kirti causes unpleasantness between Riddhima and Armaan.

videos.title: Muskaan Tells Rahul She Loves Him
videos.overview: At the marriage party, Suman introduces Nikki and Abhimanyu to Dadi and her father. Muskaan expresses her love for Rahul. Riddhima is concerned about Armaan's progress. She enquires about his treatment.

videos.title: Atul and Anjali Fall In Love
videos.overview: Anjali wants Atul to prove his love. Armaan overhears Riddhima and Muskaan's conversation. Suman’s father discusses her marriage with Siddhant.

videos.title: Nikki is Angry With Bheeshm Singh
videos.overview: Nikkita directs her ire at Bheeshm Singh for his misbehaviour. Kirti vents her frustration on Riddhima. Riddhima sees Armaan solving Muskaan's problem.

videos.title: Riddhima is Thankful to Siddhant
videos.overview: Riddhima appreciates Siddhant's role in helping Muskaan. Armaan tells Rahul about Muskaan's love for him. Riddhima remembers Siddhant. Nikkita, Suman and Siddhant share moments with Dadi.

videos.title: Dadi Objects to Nikkita's Dress
videos.overview: Armaan and Riddhima share a light moment. Dadi objects to Nikkita's dress. The medical reports about Rahul's impotency make Armaan and Riddhima anxious. Duggi accuses Armaan.

videos.title: Rahul is Upset With His Impotency
videos.overview: The news about his impotency angers Rahul and the suggestions to adopt a child makes it worse. Will this be a reason for Rahul and Muskaan to break up?

videos.title: Atul Lures Riddhima
videos.overview: It’s Rahul and Muskaan's break-up party. Meanwhile, Nikkita decides to express her love to Abhimanyu. Later, Atul lies and lures Riddhima to attend the party .

videos.title: Riddhima Takes On Atul For Lying
videos.overview: Riddhima lets out steam on Atul for lying to her. She gets emotional about her past. Nikkita wants Abhimanyu to reveal about their love to Suman. The mood is intense around Muskaan and Rahul.

videos.title: Riddhima Gets High
videos.overview: Riddhima gets high in the party, and suggests Rahul to go for adoption, as she too is adopted. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu has a face-off with Suman’s brother. Later, Riddhima expresses her love for Armaan in her drunken state.

videos.title: Riddhima Gets Very Emotional
videos.overview: A troubled Riddhima cries as Armaan does not remember anything from the past. Meanwhile, Nikkita's father wants Abhimanyu to go in for an early engagement. Riddhima passes out and Pritam kidnaps Nikkita.

videos.title: Abhimanyu Goes to Nikita's Rescue
videos.overview: Abhimanyu rushes to save Nikkita from Pritam. Meanwhile, Shashank finds Armaan in an intimate position with Riddhima. Armaan and Riddhima squabble. Anjali, Muskaan and Atul deliberately tell Armaan about Riddhima's depression.

videos.title: Armaan is Badly Injured.
videos.overview: Abhimanyu and Nikita get stuck in an unknown place. Armaan who is badly injured and unconscious is kept under observation. Riddhima breaks down as everyone prays for his recovery. Abhimanyu and Nikita become closer in the unknown place. Everyone is concerned about Armaan in the hospital and try their best to hide the truth from him.

videos.title: Abhimanyu Says He is Married
videos.overview: Armaan is kept in the dark about his medical state. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu discloses his past that shatters Nikkita. What is that past? Will Armaan find out about his injury?

videos.title: Armaan is Worried
videos.overview: Armaan asks Riddhima about his memory loss, but she avoids disclosing anything. Meanwhile, Nikkita snubs Abhimanyu. Later, an emotional Riddhima recalls her past with Armaan.

videos.title: Armaan Battles With His Memory
videos.overview: Riddhima prays for Armaan. Meanwhile, Nikkita decides to face her problem. Later, Armaan decides to find the truth about Nikkita.

videos.title: Armaan Threatens Riddhima
videos.overview: Riddhima informs Shashank about Armaan's condition. Anjali and Muskaan gather about Armaan's plan to jump off the roof if he is not given the 'basket'. Will Armaan take such an extreme step?

videos.title: The 'basket' is Revealed
videos.overview: Riddhima reveals the truth about the 'basket'. Shashank forbids Armaan from meeting Riddhima till he recovers completely. Nikkita continues to ignore Abhimanyu. Later, Armaan recalls his conversation with Shashank.

videos.title: Riddhima Jogs Armaans' Memory
videos.overview: Shashank thinks Armaan won't be fully recovered. He wants Riddhima to forget him. But, Riddhima and Anjali try to jog Armaan’s memory. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu accepts his mistake.

videos.title: Armaan Tries to Remember His Past
videos.overview: Armaan is caught trying to meet Riddhima. He gets a cold shoulder from Riddhima on any help for the forthcoming exam. Meanwhile, Nikkita continues to dig for information about Abhimanyu. What will her search reveal?

videos.title: Is Armaan Falling For Nikkita?
videos.overview: Atul uses Kirti to make Riddhima assist Armaan for his exam. Nikkita discovers the secret behind Abhimanyu refusing the surgery. He compounds the situation by not coming out with the truth. Meanwhile, Armaan is falling for Nikkita.

videos.title: Atul Gives Tips to The Children
videos.overview: While Atul and Armaan discuss the exam, Shashank wants Riddhima to stay away from his problems. Abhimanyu reveals his truth to Nikkita. Meanwhile, Shashank finds Riddhima outside the exam hall.

videos.title: Riddhima Changes The Answers
videos.overview: Riddhima finds Armaan's answers in the exam sheet to be incorrect. She sneaks into Shashank's office to change the answers. Will Riddhima succeed?

videos.title: Nikita to Continue Her Research
videos.overview: Abhimanyu asks Nikkita to continue with her research. Armaan throws a party. Meanwhile, Shashank suspects foul play in the answer papers. Will Riddhima be caught for tampering with the exam papers?

videos.title: Shashank Confronts Riddhima
videos.overview: An angry Shashank suspends Riddhima from Sanjeevni. Riddhima forbids her friends from disclosing anything to Armaan. Meanwhile, Nikkita asks Abhimanyu to drop her home. Is the relationship back on track?

videos.title: Nikita Reads Abhimanyu's Letter
videos.overview: Nikkita asks Abhimanyu to help Armaan. All of Armaan's original answers are found to be correct. Riddhima is shown proof of tampering and asked to leave Sanjeevni. Nikkita discovers a letter addressed to Abhimanyu's wife. What's in the letter?

videos.title: Riddhima Decides to Leave Armaan
videos.overview: Armaan tells Atul that he might have feelings for Riddhima. He’s upset that she has decided to stay away from him. She tells Anjali that she has to end her contact with Armaan, as she doesn’t want him to be reminded of the love he has forgotten. Will Armaan get over his love?

videos.title: Riddhima is Leaving
videos.overview: Armaan wonders why he cannot stop thinking about Riddhima. He tries to provoke her by pretending that she won’t be missed. Later, he finds out that he was going to be expelled for cheating in the exam. What will happen when he learns that Riddhima has sacrificed her career for him?

videos.title: Armaan Knows The Truth
videos.overview: Abhimanyu and Nikita tell Armaan that Riddhima had changed his answer sheet to make him pass the exam, and that Dr. Shashank is sending her away as a punishment. Armaan decides to tell her that he loves her too. He runs to find her, but will he reach her before she leaves for the airport?

videos.title: Riddhima At The Airport
videos.overview: Riddhima reaches the airport. She recalls the times spent with Armaan. Suddenly an announcement is made in which Riddhima is asked to report to the ground staff. She’s told that there’s a message about an emergency at home. Who does she meet at the airport’s reception area?

videos.title: Armaan, Riddhima are Together
videos.overview: Nikita and Atul trick Riddhima to come along with them. Shashank acknowledges Armaan’s love for Riddhima and the companionship between them. Everybody rejoices as Armaan and Riddhima are back together. Then, Armaan asks Riddhima to marry him

videos.title: Armaan and Riddhima's Engagement
videos.overview: Abhimanyu’s lawyer informs him that Jiya has refused to grant him a divorce. Atul accompanies Armaan to Shashank’s house and he asks for Riddhima’s hand in marriage. Shashank gladly agrees and meets Armaan’s family to take the talks forward. Abhimanyu feels that Nikita deserves to know about Jiya. Will he tell her?

videos.title: Armaan's Wedding Date
videos.overview: Nikita shares her wedding fantasies with Abhimanyu. He feels guilty about hiding his first marriage from her. Billy announces the dates of Armaan and Riddhima’s wedding. However, trouble awaits Abhimanyu. Nikita overhears his conversation with his divorce lawyer. How will she deal with this big revelation?

videos.title: The Engagement Day
videos.overview: At his engagement to Riddhima, Armaan realises he does not have the ring as he has left it back at the house by mistake. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu confesses his loves for Nikita in front of everyone.

videos.title: Jia Sends Flowers to Abhimanyu
videos.overview: Shashank, Padma and Anjali pamper Riddhima before getting her ready for the engagement. Abhimanyu sees bouquets in his cabins, and thinks Nikita has sent them. He’s shocked to see a note from Jia on the flowers. He warns Nikita that Jia is in India and she must stay away from him in her presence.

videos.title: Abductors Enter Sanjeevani
videos.overview: Two unidentified people enter the hospital and force Riddhima to get a patient out of the hospital. They ask her not to raise an alarm and threaten to shoot the patient if she disobeys. When Muskaan sees them, one of the abductors puts a gun to her head. Will help arrive in time?

videos.title: Armaan to The Rescue
videos.overview: The girl being abducted is a minister’s daughter who is in love with a man. But, her father is against the marriage. Riddhima learns that the abductors are Anshul and Chhote. She tells Armaan about this who decides to help the couple.

videos.title: The Minister Orders a Shootout
videos.overview: The police assure Anshul and Chhote that all their demands will be met and, therefore, they should release the hostages. However, the minister gets impatient, and orders the police to kill everyone except Prerna if they have to. Will anyone get hurt in the police action?

videos.title: Six Months Later At Sanjeevani
videos.overview: It’s been six months since the unfortunate shootout. Shashank is unable to get over the terrible memories of the unfortunate event. Nikita and Abhimanyu’s relations are less than cordial. Meanwhile, Siddhant, Tamanna, Naina and Yuvraj begin their journey as interns. Will they revive the lost spirit of Sanjeevani?

videos.title: New Interns At Sanjeevani
videos.overview: A puppy is almost killed by Siddhant’s over-speeding car. Tamana witnesses Siddhant’s aggressive behavior on the road. Meanwhile, Yuvraj saves an elderly couple from a speeding jeep. Later, Yuvraj is suspicious when Naina makes a loud entrance.

videos.title: Siddhant and Tamanna are Late
videos.overview: All the interns, including Atul, gather in the conference room. Shashank is about to address them. He is annoyed as two interns are running late on their first day itself. He’s enraged by Siddhant’s misbehaviour and suspends him and Tamanna from the orientation.

videos.title: Shashank Addresses The Interns
videos.overview: Shashank addresses the orientation but he is not impressed by the interns and Tamana apologises to him. But Shashank leaves without letting her finish with her explanation. Later, the interns are assigned their first job.

videos.title: Nikita Fills In For Kirti
videos.overview: Siddhant is clumsy in the ward and Kirti gives him the final warning. A patient’s health suddenly deteriorates, and the interns panic. Later, Kirti has to go on maternity leave and Nikita replaces her. Is she happy to fill Kirti's shoes?

videos.title: Interns Gather In The Canteen
videos.overview: While all the interns sit together in the canteen, Yuvraj stays aloof. Abhimanyu reveals to Nikita that Jia suggested her name, to fill in for Kirti, when she would be away on leave. Tamana’s father makes her swear that she’ll never expose him. Why does Tamana have to make such a promise?

videos.title: Yuvraj Enters Shashank's Cabin
videos.overview: The interns plan to go for a Dandiya dance party. Tamana refuses to join them. Atul tells Nikita how he feels about repeating a year as an intern. Yuvraj sneaks into Shashank’s cabin and checks it out. Jia invites Nikita on her wedding anniversary.

videos.title: Tamanna Forgets House Keys
videos.overview: Siddhant drops Tamana home. Jia asks Nikita to suggest the outfit that Abhimanyu would like her to wear. Yuvraj resents the fact Naina has been chosen to assist Shashank. Meanwhile, Tamana forgets her keys in Siddhant’s car. He searches for her house to give it back to her.

videos.title: Siddhant Reaches Tamanna's House
videos.overview: Tamana’s father sees Siddhant coming and hides from him. Her mother stops him from coming inSiddhante and asks him to hand over the wallet. Siddhant refuses to give it to her. He hears Tamana’s voice. Later, a man misbehaves with Naina at the Dandiya party. Yuvraj warns the man.

videos.title: Siddhant Helps In The Ram Leela
videos.overview: Siddhant helps with lights at the Ram Leela. Tamana comperes the show and also plays the character of Sita. Meanwhile, Naina tells Yuvraj that she’ll return his favour, as he saved her from eve-teasers at the party.  Later, Tamana scolds Siddhant for not handling the lights properly.

videos.title: Yuvraj Assists Shashank
videos.overview: Nikita is annoyed with the interns and she punishes them with additional tasks. Tamana and Siddhant are instructed to assist Dr. Nikita for the whole day. Nikita overhears Abhimanyu saying that he is trying to cure Jia.

videos.title: Abhimanyu Warns Siddhant
videos.overview: Nikita complains to Abhimanyu about Siddhant’s behaviour. He warns Siddhant to be careful in the future, but Siddhant continues to misbehave whichenrages Nikita even more. When a patient goes missing, Nikita questions Siddhant and Tamana about it.

videos.title: Kirti Finds The Missing Patient
videos.overview: Siddhant and Tamana panic, as they cannot find the missing patient. Then, Dr. Kirti finds her and rushes her to the ICU. Later, Siddhant apologises to Nikita and Tamana also owns up to her mistake. Will this event have repercussions on their career?

videos.title: Shashank is Angry
videos.overview: Siddhant is apologetic that Tamana is blamed for his mistake and tries to console her. Shashank is extremely disappointed with both of them. Tamana’s parents worry about the serious consequences of the events on her career. Will Tamana be able to sort out the mess?

videos.title: Jia Vows to Get Rid Of Nikita
videos.overview: Abhimanyu and Jia are celebrating their anniversary. Jia picks on Nikita as soon as she arrives and she decides to get out of there. But, just then, Abhimanyu confesses his love for Nikita. Jia overhears their conversation and vows to get rid of Nikita forever.

videos.title: Shashank Lets Yuvraj Assist
videos.overview: Shashank lets Yuvraj assist him in a surgery and informs Naina about his decision. Naina is not happy and she warns Yuvraj that there’s something fishy about him and threatens to get to the bottom of it.

videos.title: Yuvraj Acts Strange
videos.overview: Kokila Aunty, a patient, is suffering from depression. The interns feel committed to make her speak. They plan to perform a skit for her. Shashank asks Naina and Yuvraj to get ready for the surgery. Yuvraj secretly tampers with Shashank’s mask. What’s he up to?

videos.title: Naina Faints In The Ot
videos.overview: Naina wears Shashank’s mask and faints in the operation theatre. When she is revived, she realises the mask had some fluid on it. She suspects Yuvraj. Will she warn Shashank about Yuvraj’s behaviour?

videos.title: Siddhant is Punished
videos.overview: Yuvraj admits to putting fluid on Shashank’s mask. Abhimanyu asks Nikita to be lenient with Siddhant and Tamana as their careers are at stake. Nikita insists on being fair. Finally, Tamana is let off but Siddhant is punished harshly. Can his career be saved?

videos.title: Yuvraj Learns a Secret
videos.overview: Siddhant confronts Tamana for saving him from being rusticated from Sanjeevani. He tells her that he doesn’t intend to continue there. Yuvraj learns that Naina has kept the fact of her working at Sanjeevani hidden form her dad. Will he use this information to blackmail her?

videos.title: Yuvraj Stalks Naina
videos.overview: Yuvraj follows Naina to a restaurant. Her dad wants her to see a prospective groom there. Siddhant and Tamana are transferred to a rural area but Siddhant is not keen on the assignment. He requests Abhimanyu to remove him from Sanjeevani instead. Will Yuvraj confront Naina?

videos.title: Yuvraj Threatens Naina
videos.overview: Yuvraj threatens to reveal Naina’s secrets. Meanwhile, Tamana’s mother is anxious about sending her to a rural area. Naina is worried that her family might find out about her internship. Seeing her worried, Jitendra tries to calm her down.How will she get out of this situation?

videos.title: Diwali In Sanjeevani
videos.overview: Everyone is celebrating Diwali but Shashank is not in the mood for festivities. Jia tells Kirti that she also plans to have a baby like her. Naina wants to patch up with Yuvraj, so that he doesn’t reveal his internship to her parents. Meanwhile, Nikita’s saree catches fire. Will Diwali bring peace or panic to Sanjeevani?

videos.title: Jia Links Nikita With Atul
videos.overview: Jia asks Nikita and Atul to help her distribute gifts in the children’s ward. Later, she brings Abhimanyu to the ward and creates an impression that Atul and Nikita might be going around. Naina and Jignesh go to a mental hospital to probe Yuvraj’s secret when Yuvraj catches them.

videos.title: Yuvraj Scorns Naina
videos.overview: Yuvraj is enraged by Naina for trying to spy on him. He tells her she’ll never have a place in his life. Siddhant secretly plans to go to Houston. He does not answer Abhimanyu’s calls. Tamana is tense as her career is in danger. Will the other interns learn about Siddhant’s plan?

videos.title: Abhimanyu Goes and Complaints About Jia to The Doctor
videos.overview: The episode starts with Jia and Abhimanyu quarreling. It's because Abhimanyu is in love with Nikita and not his wife. Meanwhile Jitendra gets stuck in a window. Nikita, Atul and Tamana try to get him out. Yuvraj manages to get him out. Everybody starts searching Siddhant's house. Abhimanyu goes and complaints about Jia to the doctor. But the doctor supports Jia. Shashank tells Tamana that she will have to go to the orphanage with Siddhant.

videos.title: Tamanna's Father Falls Ill
videos.overview: Tamana’s father falls ill and is admitted in Sanjeevani. The interns request Kirti to forgive Tamana, but she says it’s Shashank’s call. To attract Yuvraj's attention, Naina pretends that she has a boyfriend. Tamana’s mother comes to look after her father. Will Shashank forgive Tamana?

videos.title: Tamanna and Siddhant Reach Mumbai
videos.overview: Tamana apologises to Siddhant for her behaviour. Abhimanyu tells Jia that he has dismissed Nikita and she’s delighted with the news. Tamana and Siddhant reach Mumbai. There, her father is looking for a prospective groom for her. Will Tamana and Siddhant find some chemistry?

videos.title: Siddhant and Tamanna Expelled
videos.overview: Shashank expels Siddhant and Tamana. Siddhant pleads for one more chance for both of them. Abhimanyu tells Jia he’s leaving her forever. She pretends to hurt herself to stop him. Will Jia succeed in emotionally blackmailing him? Will Shashank give Tamana and Siddhant a last chance?

videos.title: Nikita Snaps Ties With Abhimanyu
videos.overview: Jia goes to Nikita’s house to apologise to her. Tamana and Siddhant share some playful moments with each other, as they get a lift from an old couple in their car. Nikita tells Abhimanyu that she doesn’t love him. Will their love succumb to Jia’s plotting, while Tamana and Siddhant bask in each other’s presence?

videos.title: Jia Sets Nikita's Saree On Fire
videos.overview: Diwali celebrations brighten up Sanjeevani. However; Yuvraj behaves rudely with Naina and tells her she can never be friends with him. Tamana is upset about her father’s health. Jia is out to hurt Nikita and she sets her saree on fire. What will be Nikita’s fate?

videos.title: Siddhanth Saves Tamanna
videos.overview: Siddhanth saves Tamanna from being molested by the driver. Later, Tamanna asks him to return to America after his project. Meanwhile, Naina prevents Yuvraj and Jitender Prasad from tormenting Jignesh.  Why are they torturing Jignesh?

videos.title: Naina's Father Comes to Mumbai
videos.overview: Naina’s father comes to Mumbai. She’s scared as she might not be able to conceal her profession from him. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu sends Nikita a letter written in blood. Tamana and Siddhant visit the rural area they are transferred to. Will Naina’s father find out that she’s pursuing medicine?

videos.title: Will Naina's Lie be Exposed?
videos.overview: Abhimanyu is shocked that Nikita has received a letter in his name, which he did not send. He confronts Jia about it. Tamana suggests that Siddhant should play with the kids to befriend them. Naina’s father sees her in the hospital. Is her lie about to be exposed?

videos.title: Yuvraj Tells a Lie For Nikita
videos.overview: Yuvraj tells Naina to come up with a lie to justify her reason for being in the hospital. Atul asks Nikita to stay away from Abhimanyu, as he knows how it must hurt her to be around him. Naina asks Yuvraj to pretend to be her boyfriend. Will Yuvraj develop a soft corner for Naina?

videos.title: Naina's Father Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Naina’s father finds out that she’s a doctor. Siddhant confronts the head of the society for stopping him from treating kids from all castes. Will Naina’s father support her dream? Will Siddhant continue to fight for the rights of the kids?

videos.title: Jia is Injured
videos.overview: Jia gets injured, and everybody thinks Nikita tried to kill her. Shashank decides to call the police to look into the matter. Abhimanyu insists on probing jia’s injury and asks him to wait until the reports come. Meanwhile, Tamana and Siddhant get lost in a jungle and take shelter in a cottage.

videos.title: Jia Blackmails Abhimanyu
videos.overview: Jia blackmails Abhimanyu and makes him promise he’ll never leave her, if he wants Nikita to be saved. Yuvraj looks for Shashank’s case file which is at his house. Later, Yuvraj overhears Naina telling JP that she will stay at Shashank’s house. Will Abhimanyu agree to Jia’s demand. to save Nikita?

videos.title: Is Siddhant Falling For Tamanna?
videos.overview: Siddhant feels awkward when Tamana apologises to him. Meanwhile, Jia is delighted that Abhimanyu has dismissed Nikita. Yuvraj tells Naina’s father that he is not her boyfriend. Later, Tamana’s mother suspects that she’s having an affair.

videos.title: Siddhant Falls For Tamanna
videos.overview: Yuvraj does not want Naina to follow him. Siddhant thinks he is in love with Tamana but is not completely sure. Abhimanyu comes to know that Jia has stabbed herself and Nikki was not involved in the incident. He asks everyone to keep an eye on Jia. Will he be able to stop Jia from committing suicide?

videos.title: Siddhant Wants to Meet Tamanna
videos.overview: Siddhant wants to meet Tamana but is confused how to express his feelings to her. Tamana asks the children to stop Siddhant from coming to her house as she is worried about the meeting. Goons flirt with Naina and Yuvraj saves her, which surprises Naina. What

videos.title: Siddhant Meets Tamanna
videos.overview: Siddhant meets Tamana but is unable to express his feelings for her. Jia goes to Nikki’s house to kill her but Abhimanya reaches on time with the police. Will Jia’s real nature be revealed in front of all?

videos.title: Naina Overhears Mark
videos.overview: Naina overhears Mac and his friend talking about Yuvraj and the race. Tamana’s parents welcome the bridegroom’s family, who have come to see Tamana. Her mother is unable to find Tamana in her room and searches for her everywhere. Will she be able to find her?

videos.title: Tamanna Meets Guests
videos.overview: Tamana’s mother scolds her for meeting Siddhant and introduces her to the guests. Naina tries to warn Yuvraj about Mac's plan but they start the race. Eventually, she manages to get Yuvraj out of trouble, but the police arrive at the place. Will they be able to hide from the police?

videos.title: Siddhant and Tamanna Talk
videos.overview: Yuvraj drops Naina to Dr. Shashank’s house where she enquires about everyone in the family. Siddhant and Tamana talk to each other and Siddhant tries to express his feelings for her. Will she understad his feelings?

videos.title: Naina Meets Mac
videos.overview: Siddhant and Tamana come face to face but do not talk to each other. Naina meets Mac in the hospital and gets to know that Yuvraj has come to take revenge. What are Yuvraj's plans?

videos.title: Yuvraj Throws a Party
videos.overview: Jitendra asks Yuvraj to throw a party and he agrees. Siddhant apologises to Tamana for the previous night and invites her to the party but she refuses to go.  Will Yuvraj and Naina meet?

videos.title: Tamanna and Diya Attend The Party
videos.overview: Tamana and Diya attend the party, where Siddhant introduces everyone to Diya and dances with her. Tamana gets jealous seeing them dance together and leaves the party. Naina confronts Yuvraj about his revenge plans. Will Siddhant stop Tamana from leaving?

videos.title: Tamanna and Diya Attend The Party
videos.overview: Tamana and Diya attend the party, where Siddhant introduces everyone to Diya and dances with her. Tamana gets jealous to see them dance together and decides to leave the party. Naina confronts Yuvraj about the revenge. Will Siddhant stop Tamana from leaving? Will Yuvraj answer Naina’s questions?

videos.title: Naina Talks to Yuvraj
videos.overview: Naina reveals to yuvraj that she is aware of his plan and will not get trapped. Siddhant tells everyone that Tamana is Umar’s daughter, which comes as a shock to all. She tells Siddhant that she loves her father and does not want to hurt him. Will Siddhant apologise for his mistake to Tamana?

videos.title: Siddhant Apologises to Umar
videos.overview: An unknown person visits the hospital and asks Siddhant if Tamana works in the same hospital. Meanwhile, Siddhant wants to impress Tamana and so asks his friends to apologise to Umar; and Umar blesses Siddhant for respecting him. The interns plan to go for a picnic. Will Tamana join her friends?

videos.title: Siddhant Visits Tamanna's House
videos.overview: Siddhant visits Tamana’s house and gives her a surprise. She asks him to leave but he refuses to do so. The groom’s family comes to Tamana’s house. What will happen if they find Siddhant in the house? Will get away in time?

videos.title: Siddhant Visits Tamanna's House
videos.overview: Siddhant visits Tamana’s house and gives her a surprise. She asks him to leave but he refuses to do so. The groom’s family makes a visit to Tamana’s house. What will happen if they find Siddhant in the house? Will Siddhant escape the house in time?

videos.title: The Interns Help Siddhant
videos.overview: Tamana’s mother asks Tamana to comfort Aniketh’s family. Naina and Yuvraj also reach Tamana’s house in search of Siddhant. They try to save Siddhant from getting trapped. The interns want Siddhant to declare his love to Tamana. Will he be able to?

videos.title: Siddhant to Propose to Tamanna?
videos.overview: Siddhant decides to profess his love to Tamana but is not able to muster up the courage. Yuvraj bets Naina that Tamana will turn down Siddhant’s proposal even if he gathers the courage to speak. Later, Aniketh visits the hospital to meet Tamana & the interns try to listen in to their conversation.

videos.title: Siddhant Apologises to Tamanna
videos.overview: Siddhant tries to apologise to Tamana, but she tells him about her status, upsetting him. Yuvraj is caught by Naina while sneaking into her house, but he asks her out on a date. Naina joins Yuvraaj on the date. Will Yuvraj be able to impress Naina? Will Siddhant be able to win Tamana’s heart?

videos.title: Tamanna Concerned About Siddhant
videos.overview: Tamana is concerned about Siddhant’s health even as he tries to adjust to her standard of living. Jiggy wants to keep Jitendra’s birthday a secret and comes back to the hospital. Yuvraj gets to know that Naina took help from Dr Shashank in his brother’s case. Will he be able to forgive Naina?

videos.title: Tamanna Helps Siddhant
videos.overview: Siddhant and his friends get Tamana’s help to clean the place. Tamana treats Yuvraj’s brother and seek Shashank’s help. Yuvraj surprises Naina and takes her on a date. She reaches hospital late and gives Shashank a false excuse for the delay. Will Shashank come to know the real reason?

videos.title: Tamanna is Concerned For Siddhant
videos.overview: Tamana is concerned about Siddhant’s health even as he tries to adjust to her standard of living. Jiggy wants to keep Jitendra’s birthday a secret and comes back to the hospital. Yuvraj gets to know that Naina took help from Dr. Shashank in his brother’s case. Will he be able to forgive Naina?

videos.title: Tamanna Gets High
videos.overview: Tamana gets high at the party and talks badly to Siddhant. Later, when they get close, Siddhant asks her not to marry Aniket. An injured Samrat is brought to the hospital by his friends and they are anxious tense because of his condition. Will the doctors be able to cure Samrat?

videos.title: Siddhant Speaks to Tamanna
videos.overview: Siddhant speaks out his heart to Taman,  but fears that she will forget everything once she is sober. Naina and Yuvraj break into a garment shop after getting drunk and Shashank notices them. Will Shashank confront them?

videos.title: Shashank Confronts Naina
videos.overview: Shashank confronts Naina and she, in turn, enquires about Riddhima. Tamana is confused about her previous night’s meeting with Siddhant. Siddhant tries to talk to Tamana, but Aniket takes her with him. Yuvraj discloses everything about Siddhant to Taman and Aniket. How will Aniket react?

videos.title: Naina Meets Yuvraj's Brother
videos.overview: Yuvraj discloses Siddhant’s deeds in front of Tamana which makes her furious. Tamana does not allow Siddhant to explain anything to her. Naina meets Yuvraj’s brother. What will she say to him?

videos.title: Atul Clears His Exams
videos.overview: Atul clears his exam as a reSiddhantent. Shashank tells Naina that the dispensary opening has to be conducted on December 25, and the list has to be ready by then. Yuvraj comes forward to help her with the opening arrangements. Abhimanyu visits Nikita. What will he tell her?

videos.title: Naina Gets Worried
videos.overview: Naina is worried about the arrangements, but Yuvraj assures her of his help and asks her to find out that why Shahshank wants the opening to be on 25th December. Siddhant gets to know that Tamana and Aniket are meeting for lunch.

videos.title: Atul Gets Angry With Naina
videos.overview: Atul is angry with Naina as she is not working properly. Tamana visits a restaurant to meet Aniket but runs into Siddhant instead. Yuvraj tells Naina about his family. Will Naina understand Yuvraj?

videos.title: Tamanna Confronts Siddhant
videos.overview: Tamana confronts Siddhant for lying to Aniket and eventually agrees to marry Aniket. Yuvraj plans a layout for Sanjeevni’s new clinic and asks Naina to make sure that it is inaugurated by Shashank. Why?

videos.title: Tamanna Decides to Marry Aniket
videos.overview: Siddhant tells Jitendar and Jiggy that Tamanna has decided to marry Aniket. Meanwhile, Yuvraj tells Naina that he loves her. He is sure that she is going to hate him soon. Siddhant is heartbroken because of Tamanna’s decision. Yuvraj recalls his promise of taking revenge on Shashank.

videos.title: Tamanna's Mom Talks to Siddhant
videos.overview: Tamana’s mother is anxious to know about the relationship between Tamana and Siddhant and gets shocked to know from Siddhant that they are in love with each other. Tamana gets to know this and asks Siddhant to talk to her in private.

videos.title: An Invitation From Tamanna
videos.overview: Tamana invites everyone for her engagement with Aniket. Naina finds an old newspaper article that falls from Yuvraj’s pocket. She enquires about the old case files in the record room. Shashank is shocked to hear Yuvraj’s suggestion.

videos.title: Naina Finds Out About Yuvraj
videos.overview: Naina learns of Yuvraj’s real purpose at the Sanjeevani hospital. Siddhant confesses his love for Tamana but she refuses to go against her parents' wishes. What will Siddhant do in order to prevent Tamana from getting engaged to Aniket?

videos.title: Siddhant and Friends have a Plan
videos.overview: Jitendra, Jiggy and Siddhant plan to kidnap Tamana. Aniket tells Siddhant that after marriage he will take Tamana to Canada. As per the plan, Jitendra and Jiggy switch off the lights and try to kidnap Tamana. Will their attempt be successful?

videos.title: Abhimanyu Proposes to Nikita
videos.overview: Abhimanyu proposes to Nikita and slides a ring onto her finger. Tamana makes Siddhant realise that he does not love her and he accepts the fact. Yuvraj abducts Naina when he comes to know that she knows the truth about him.

videos.title: Shashank Misses Riddhima
videos.overview: Yuvraj plans to take revenge on Shashank, holding him responsible for his mother’s death and brother’s condition. Shashank sees Riddhima’s photos and thinks about his daughter. Riddhima returns to India but tells Atul that she cannot come to Sanjeevani. Will she meet Shashank?

videos.title: Yuvraj Blames Dr Shashank
videos.overview: Dr Shashank cuts the ribbon for the inauguration, and Dr Kirti tells him that the entire media was arranged by Yuvraj. Yuvraj addresses the media and invites Dr Shashank to the stage. He blames Dr Shashank for killing his father.

videos.title: Shashank Gets Injured
videos.overview: Shashank gets injured while saving Aviraj from a short circuit. Riddhima comes to Sanjeevani and meets Shashank, Atul and Nikita. Atul asks Riddhima about Arman which makes her upset. Naina proves Shashank's innocence by revealing the reason for Aviraj’s paralysis.

videos.title: Yuvraj Feels Sorry
videos.overview: Yuvraj is sorry for conspiring against Shashank and tries to convince Naina, but Siddhant threatens him for harassing her.  Siddhant then confronts Naina and becomes aggressive towards her. Will Naina forgive Siddhant?

videos.title: Yuvraj Apologises to Shashank
videos.overview: Yuvraj apologises to Shashank and tells him that he will leave Sanjeevani, but Shashank asks him to stay. Riddhima is shocked to know that Siddhant is an intern at Sanjeevani. Padma asks Shashank to tell Riddhima the truth about Armaan. What truth is she talking about?

videos.title: Abhimanyu and Nikita Get Engaged
videos.overview: Riddhima and Siddhant argue and she is surprised to learn that he is Abhimanyu’s brother. The interns are shocked to know that Riddhima is Shashank’s daughter. The interns prepare for Abhimanyu and Nikita’s engagement. The doctors plan a basketball match to lighten the mood.

videos.title: Riddhima Challenges Siddhant
