videos.overview: Siddhant convinces Naina to play the basketball match. Riddhima challenges Siddhant in the match and they end up arguing during the match. Riddhima asks Shashank to send her back abroad. Will Shashank let Riddhima go?

videos.title: The Doctors Play Basketball
videos.overview: All the doctors participate in the basketball match and the seniors cheat against the juniors during the game. Riddhima gets angry when she notices the juniors having higher points. She starts crying, remembering Armaan.

videos.title: Riddhima and Siddhant Argue
videos.overview: Yuvraj gets compliments for his acute observations on a patient’s injuries. Meanwhile, Sanjeevani comes up with new rules, which upsets the interns. Riddhima and Siddhant argue with each other and she slaps the cake on his face. Siddhant gets emotional when she tells him about Tamana. Will Siddhant be able to forget Tamana?

videos.title: Goons Attack Yuvraj and Naina
videos.overview: Some goons attack Yuvraj and Naina. Riddhima shouts at Siddhant as he plays with a child in the hospital and he complains against Riddhima to Kirti. Will Kirti take action against Riddhima or will Siddhant take revenge himself?

videos.title: Naina Questions Yuvraj
videos.overview: Naina questions Yuvraj about the goons and he gets upset. Kirti informs the interns about Siddhant and Riddhima’s trip to Lonavala, for a case study. Siddhant ties Riddhima to a chair and leaves her in a store room. Will she be able to escape?

videos.title: Naina Expresses Her Love
videos.overview: Naina tries to express her feelings for Yuvraj. Shashank and Riddhima attend to Tamana as she faints. Riddhima files a police complaint against Siddhant and he is arrested. Will Riddhima and Shashank be able to save Siddhant?

videos.title: Siddhant Decides to Take Revenge
videos.overview: Yuvraj and Naina spend quality time with each other and then he gets a mysterious call. Siddhant is angry to see Riddhima getting him released on bail. Siddhant decides to take revenge on Riddhima. Will he succeed?

videos.title: Riddhima Gets Angry With Siddhant
videos.overview: Riddhima gives instructions to the interns about their duties, but Siddhant refuses to do the duty assigned to him. Riddhima gets angry with Siddhant and he plans to take revenge on her. He clicks some photos of her, without her consent.

videos.title: Riddhima Gets Shocked
videos.overview: The hospital people are talking about the photos and Riddhima gets a shock when she sees them. Siddhant feels guilty and confesses to Riddhima. Siddhant apologises to Riddhima. Will she forgive him?

videos.title: Siddhant Apologises to Riddhima
videos.overview: Kirti calls everyone to the reception area where Siddhant confesses his mistake and apologises to Riddhima. Atul sympathises with Riddhima and she decides to leave Sanjeevani. Siddhant comes to Riddhima’s cabin to talk to her. Will she forgive him?

videos.title: Shashank Gets Disappointed
videos.overview: Siddhant decides to leave Sanjeevani which upsets everyone. Siddhant is shocked to know Riddhima’s real intentions and decides to teach her a lesson. Shashank is disappointed with Riddhima and talks to Padma about her. Riddhima overhears their conversation and is very surprised. What does she hear?

videos.title: Riddhima Learns About Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima gets upset when she discovers the truth about Armaan. Tamanna refuses to undergo her surgery till Siddhant convinces her. On being questioned by Riddhima, Dr Shashank gets tensed and reveals the truth about Armaan. Riddhima yells at Shashank for not telling her the truth.

videos.title: Riddhima Finds a Clue
videos.overview: Riddhima gets very upset over Armaan and berates her mother. Sad and hurt, Shashank seeks help from Siddhant. Riddhima forces Dr Keerti to help her look for Armaan. They look for clues in the locker room and discover the believed whereabouts of Armaan. Will they find him there?

videos.title: Riddhima Goes to Panchgani
videos.overview: Riddhima imagines Armaan's presence in the hospital. Sidhdhant decides to be with Riddhima and help her. Yuvraj comes across a patient he knows. Riddhima gets into a bus for Panchgani to look for Armaan. Siddhant follows her and gets in the bus as well.

videos.title: Siddhant Meets Armaan's Father
videos.overview: Riddhima gets angry on seeing Siddhant. Yuvraj plans to throw Raj out of the hospital. Siddhant meets Armaan's father, who tells him that Riddhima declared that she will find Armaan or die. Later, Siddhant sees a part of Riddhima's clothing floating in the water and fears the worst.

videos.title: Siddhant Meets Armaan's Father
videos.overview: Riddhima gets angry on seeing Siddhant. Yuvraj plans to throw Raj out of the hospital. Siddhant meets Armaan's father, who tells him that Riddhima declared that she will find Armaan or die. Later, Siddhant sees a part of Riddhima's clothing floating in the water and fears the worst.

videos.title: Bandits Attack Siddhant
videos.overview: Riddhima doesn't appreciate Siddhant's help and yells at him. Siddhant tells her that he will help her find Armaan. While on their way to look for Armaan, some bandits attack the duo. Siddhant risks his life to get Ridhima’s anklet back. Will he get harmed?

videos.title: Villagers Help Siddhant
videos.overview: Hurt by the bandits, Siddhant falls unconscious. Some villagers find him and Riddhima nurses him. At Sanjeevani, Naina and Yuvraj spend some romantic time together. Jignesh sees this and feels heartbroken. During a function in the village, Riddhima hears a familiar voice. Who could it be?

videos.title: Riddhima Finds Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima hears Armaan's voice and runs towards it. She finds a house where she finds her and Armaan's photos, Armaan's helmet, her bangle and anklet. Armaan makes a sudden appearance and sees Riddhima fainting. Armaan vanishes just as suddenly, leaving a letter. What does the letter say?

videos.title: Riddhima's Health Worsens
videos.overview: Riddhima falls ill and her condition worsens. A worried Siddhant calls Dr Atul, who tells him that Riddhima has hypothermia. Atul advises him to keep her warm. Despite a blanket, Riddhima's temperature drops further. What can Siddhant do to save Riddhima?

videos.title: Riddhima Attempts Suicide
videos.overview: Siddhant tells Riddhima what happened the previous night. Riddhima feels terrible. Meanwhile, Dr Kirti, Naina, JP and Jiggy get stuck in a lift, just as Dr Kirti experiences labour pains. With no way out, she delivers inside the lift. Riddhima attempts suicide. Will Siddhant stop her?

videos.title: Riddhima Accuses Siddhant
videos.overview: Riddhima accuses Siddhant of raping her. Siddhant tries to convince everyone but all his efforts are rebuked. Raj's condition worsens. Kirti asks Riddhima to undergo tests to confirm the rape. Dr Shashank berates Siddhant for what happened. Will Siddhant be able to prove otherwise?

videos.title: Siddhant Proven Innocent
videos.overview: Dr Shashank inspects Riddhima's medical report and admits that he was wrong in accusing Siddhant. He tells Siddhant that Riddhima is in a state of shock. Raj steals morphine from the hospital. What is he planning to do with it?

videos.title: Police Find Drugs With Riddhima
videos.overview: Raj hides the morphine in Riddhima's bag. Meanwhile, Siddhant has an accident, which draws the police's attention. Kirti rebukes Riddhima for falsely accusing Siddhant. The police suspect Riddhima's involvement in the accident. On inspecting Riddhima's purse, the police find drugs and arrest her.

videos.title: Riddhima is Released
videos.overview: On hearing about Riddhima's arrest, Siddhant testifies to secure her release. Riddhima thanks him for helping her. Riddhima feels bad listening to the taunts and comments passed about her by her colleagues. Sister Stella tells Shashank about the incidents involving Riddhima and Siddhant.

videos.title: Siddhant Offers to Marry Riddhima
videos.overview: Shashank berates Siddhant for ruining Riddhima's reputation. As a solution, Siddhant offers to marry Riddhima, who immediately declines the suggestion. Yuvraj gives Naina a Valentine's Day gift. After a lot of persuasion from Shashank, Riddhima finally agrees to marry Siddhant.

videos.title: Riddhima Wants a Quick Wedding
videos.overview: Riddhima asks Shashank to arrange for a quick wedding. Siddhant doesn't involve his parents in the wedding and pretends to be happy in front of Naina. Riddhima feels sad when she remembers Armaan. Siddhant asks Riddhima to forget the past and start a new life. Can Riddhima do so?

videos.title: Siddhant Proposes to Riddhima
videos.overview: Siddhant buys a wedding ring for Riddhima. Naina advises Siddhant to impress Riddhima and win her love. Siddhant proposes to Riddhima and shows her the wedding ring. While she doesn't reciprocate his enthusiasm, she feels happy to see Anjali arrive. Yuvraj gets furious to see Raj at the wedding.

videos.title: Riddhima Attempts Suicide Again
videos.overview: Siddhant feels sad when Riddhima confesses that she still has feelings for Armaan. Yuvraj and Raj have an altercation and Yuvraj punches him. Siddhant is delighted to see his sister, Suvarna. Riddhima, still upset and unhappy, attempts suicide again. Will she survive this time?

videos.title: Riddhima Survives Poison

Later, Armaan and Shilpa are asked to go to Panchgani as visiting doctors. Is it a plan to get them together?

videos.title: Shashank Gets Injured
videos.overview: Shilpa secretly interchanges a tetanus injection with a multi-vitamin injection. Shashank gets injured and is treated by Armaan. A tetanus injection has to be administered to Shashank. Will Armaan accidentally give Shashank the wrong injection?

videos.title: Shilpa Challenges Armaan Again
videos.overview: Riddhima gets upset when Siddhant goes to a club without telling her. Meanwhile, some goons flirt with Shilpa and Armaan fights them off. Yuvraaj informs Jaggy and JP about his plans to go to the US. Shilpa challenges Armaan. What is it this time?

videos.title: Siddhant Kisses Riddhima
videos.overview: Shilpa lays a number of challenges before Armaan. They get into trouble with the police due to this. Siddhant sneaks into Riddhima's house to console her. Siddhant kisses Riddhima. While she asks him to leave, she feels happy about what happened. What new trouble will Shilpa cause for Armaan?

videos.title: Shilpa Gets Armaan Arrested
videos.overview: Shilpa places Armaan's picture on the 'wanted' board in the police station. Armaan is arrested due to this. At the hospital, while Shilpa bosses over Siddhant, Jaggy and JP try to impress her. Later, Shilpa makes an announcement in the hospital. What does she say?

videos.title: Riddhima Scolds Shilpa
videos.overview: Shilpa announces that Siddhant loves Riddhima. Riddhima gets embarrassed and angry with the announcement. Shilpa tries to convince Riddhima, but gets scolded in return. Later, Riddhima chides Siddhant and asks him to behave like a doctor when he's at work. Armaan wonders if Shilpa is right for him.

videos.title: Shilpa Dances In The Hospital
videos.overview: Armaan convinces the inspector to let him make a phone call. Shilpa's unique ways of treatment catch everyone's attention. She dances in the hospital to get a reaction from a patient who is suffering from bi-polar disorder. Will the patient regain consciousness?

videos.title: Riddhima Berates Shilpa
videos.overview: Riddhima berates Shilpa for breaching the hospital's rules. She insults and ridicules her actions. However, Shilpa’s colleagues defend her. Shilpa soon finds out Armaan's identity and is worried about the consequences. Will Armaan forgive Shilpa?

videos.title: Armaan Returns From Jail
videos.overview: While Shilpa researches Armaan's position and achievements, he plots revenge against her. Meanwhile, Siddhant expresses his wish to take Riddhima home. When she comes to his house, Siddhant performs rituals to welcome her. Meanwhile, Armaan reaches the hospital, unaware of Shilpa's presence.

videos.title: Shilpa Escapes From Armaan
videos.overview: Armaan sees Shilpa and confronts her at the hospital. But Shilpa pretends to faint and escapes from a face-off. Later, when Armaan blames Shilpa, she feigns complete ignorance and says that she has amnesia. Will Armaan forgive her and move on?

videos.title: Shilpa Escapes With Armaan's Bike
videos.overview: Armaan believes that Shilpa has amnesia. Meanwhile, Shilpa gets away with Armaan's bike. Meanwhile, Siddhant and Riddhima get closer and their romance grows. Armaan confronts Shilpa about the bike incident, but she escapes yet again, citing amnesia as a reason.

videos.title: Armaan Finds Out Shilpa's Truth
videos.overview: Dr Kirti hands over an intern's file to Armaan. Shilpa sees this and fears it is hers. She tries her best to get her hands on it but isn't able to. When Shilpa's identity is revealed, Armaan gets angry. Meanwhile, Dr Dhruv arrives at the hospital to discuss a case with Armaan.

videos.title: Riddhima Accidentally Hugs Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima plans a surprise for Siddhant and invites him to the gallery. Armaan coincidentally arrives and Riddhima accidentally hugs him. Siddhant arrives late, which Riddhima doesn't like. Armaan swears revenge from Shilpa. What will he do?

videos.title: Armaan's Prank On Shilpa
videos.overview: Armaan requests Shilpa to assist him on a case. The patient undergoes paralysis due to a mistake and Armaan blames Shilpa. Later, Armaan reveals it to be a prank but Shilpa gets very upset about it. Will Armaan make peace with Shilpa?

videos.title: Armaan Pacifies Shilpa
videos.overview: Still upset over Armaan's prank, Shilpa feels hurt and sad. Armaan regrets his actions and apologises to her. When duties are being assigned to interns, Shilpa refuses to work with Armaan. This increases the enmity between them.

videos.title: Armaan and Shilpa Argue
videos.overview: JP shares some tips on love with Siddhant and he tries to use them with Riddhima. Meanwhile, Armaan gets suspicious about a patient admitted in the hospital. He enquires about the wounds inflicted. He tries to inform the police, but Shilpa feels he is overreacting.

videos.title: The Police Appreciate Armaan
videos.overview: On being constantly questioned by Armaan, the patient in question reveals the truth to him. The police enquire about the incident and the patient is grateful to Armaan. Meanwhile, Siddhant plans another date with Riddhima and she agrees to go out with him.

videos.title: Dr Shashank's Announcement
videos.overview: Armaan welcomes Shilpa at a party and tries to improve their relationship. However, an unfortunate incident creates a rift between them. Dr Shashank announces Riddhima as the disciplinary officer to maintain decorum at the hospital. What went wrong in the party?

videos.title: Shilpa's Revenge Against Armaan
videos.overview: Shilpa plans to get even with Armaan. On her behest, JP lures Armaan to a particular corridor. Armaan gets hurt by a rusted iron rod. Shilpa replaces a tetanus injection with a sleep walking injection and hopes to exact revenge. Will this prove to be harmful?

videos.title: Shilpa is In Love
videos.overview: During a meeting in the hospital, Shashank talks about the need for discipline. Riddhima, Arman and Shilpa exchange heated words during the meeting. Shashank shows some video footage which is discussed. Shilpa realises that she is in love with Armaan.

videos.title: A New In-charge In The Hospital
videos.overview: Riddhima argues with Siddhant and then with Armaan. Shashank calls a meeting in the hospital and announces the name of the new person in-charge of discipline in the hospital. Armaan and JP feel jealous, while Riddhima argues with Shashank. Who is the new in-charge?

videos.title: Sid Tries to Take Control
videos.overview: Armaan, JP and Jiggy plan to harass Siddhant. Shilpa's feelings for Armaan get stronger. Upset over the lack of support for him, Siddhant tries control the staff. Riddhima is concerned about Shashank's decision. Will this affect Riddhima and Siddhant's personal life?

videos.title: Shilpa Supports Sid
videos.overview: Thanks to Armaan, JP and Jiggy, Siddhant's face is blackened. He gets upset when he notices this and expresses his pain. While Siddhant vows to correct his colleagues' behaviour, Riddhima feels sad for him and apologises. Shilpa supports Siddhant, which leads to an argument between her and Armaan.

videos.title: Riddhima Helps Sid
videos.overview: Shilpa taunts Arman and they argue. Siddhant is confused about assigning duty doctors and Riddhima helps him. Later, Riddhima laughs and jokes with Siddhant at home. Meanwhile, Shilpa finds a paper on the floor. What does it contain?

videos.title: Armaan Destroys All Memories
videos.overview: On realising that Armaan still misses her, Riddhima tries to talk to Armaan. The conversation doesn't go well and Riddhima misunderstands what Armaan says. Upset and angry, Armaan destroys all the notes, photos and letters he has of Riddhima. Is this truly the end of their association?

videos.title: Siddhant Disciplines Jp and Jaggy
videos.overview: Shilpa finds documents in a garbage bin, reads through them, and is curious to know whose notes they are. Siddhant starts disciplining Jiggy and JP. Some children refuse to take their medicine in the hospital when Shilpa narrates a love story to them. Will Siddhant approve of her method?

videos.title: Riddhima Advises Sid
videos.overview: Armaan fights with Shilpa but Siddhant stops them. Armaan connects what Shilpa said to his past with Riddhima. Irritated by their constant arguments, Siddhant orders Armaan to work with Shilpa amicably. Riddhima asks Siddhant to not to get on an ego trip. Will her words hurt him?

videos.title: Riddhima's Birthday Party
videos.overview: Shilpa and Armaan spend some time together. Siddhant plans Riddhima's birthday party and invites Armaan and Shilpa. Armaan, who is with Shilpa, remembers his and Riddhima's past and leaves Shilpa alone. Will Armaan's strange behaviour lessen Shilpa's feelings for him?

videos.title: Armaan Drinks Country Liquor
videos.overview: Armaan drinks country liquor from a roadside vendor. Shilpa follows him and it starts raining. Concerned about the party, Siddhant asks Armaan to return as soon as possible. On the way the car breaks down. Will they be able to get back?

videos.title: Armaan is Injured In a Fight
videos.overview: Shilpa and Armaan see a promotion for a street-fighting contest. Shilpa announces Armaan’s name for the fight and they end up arguing.  Shilpa instigates Armaan to fight and he agrees. While Armaan fights well and shows a clear upper hand over his opponent, the wily opponent cheats and badly injures Armaan.

videos.title: Shilpa Takes Armaan Home
videos.overview: Guilty for making Armaan participate in a street fight, Shilpa takes him home. She tends to his wounds and there are several moments when she is on the verge of expressing her feelings for him. Meanwhile, Siddhant frantically tries to reach Armaan even as Shilpa tries to stitch Armaan's wounds.

videos.title: Armaan Goes to Wish Riddhima
videos.overview: Armaan remembers the special effort that Riddhima would make, to make his birthday special. With that in mind, in spite of his injuries, Armaan goes to wish Riddhima. However, Shilpa tells Armaan that Riddhima wants to spend her birthday only with Siddhant. Will this deter Armaan?

videos.title: Armaan Doesn't Blame Shilpa
videos.overview: Siddhant notices Armaan's injuries. Armaan refuses to blame Shilpa, and lies that he had a fall. At Riddhima's birthday party, Jitendra and Jiggy coax Siddhant into saying something romantic to Riddhima. When Siddhant does so, Armaan feels jealous. Meanwhile, Shilpa thinks about Armaan.

videos.title: Shilpa Arranges The Party
videos.overview: Siddhant asks Shilpa to help arrange the birthday party for Riddhima. To Riddhima and Armaan's surprise, Shilpa arranges the party exactly the way Armaan celebrated Riddhima's birthdays in the past. How did Shilpa know about the exact arrangement for the party?

videos.title: Riddhima’s Birthday Party
videos.overview: At her birthday party, Armaan is dejected when he sees Riddhima. Later, he consumes alcohol and starts arguing with Riddhima and Siddhanth. Meanwhile, Riddhima criticises Shilpa for lying to her.

videos.title: Armaan Apologises to Riddhima
videos.overview: Shilpa promises to herself to clear the misunderstandings between her and Riddhima. In the meantime, Riddhima is disappointed when she remembers Armaan's behaviour at the party. Armaan apologises to Riddhima and Siddhant asks Riddhima to forgive Armaan. Is Armaan taking advantage of Siddhant's good nature?

videos.title: Riddhima Asks Armaan to Move On
videos.overview: Riddhima asks Armaan to forget the past and move on. Armaan finds it hard to get over Riddhima. Shilpa goes to the recreation room and finds Armaan there. She asks Armaan's reasons for his self-loathing and hurting, but he gets angry with her.

videos.title: Riddhima and Arman Work Together
videos.overview: Worried about Armaan, Riddhima requests Siddhant to assign her to work with Armaan, in order to help him. Armaan and Riddhima work together, but argue over the best treatment for a particular patient. Eventually Riddhima agrees with Armaan, which surprises but also disappoints him.

videos.title: Shilpa Attends Prabhat Pheri
videos.overview: Armaan offers Shilpa his jacket and takes her on his bike. Meanwhile, Siddhant hurts his back. Later, Shilpa and Armaan do not hold off their constant bickering much longer and they start arguing again. Riddhima comes and Shilpa falls silent. Will Riddhima scold them for their fights?

videos.title: Armaan Gives His Jacket to Shilpa
videos.overview: Armaan offers Shilpa his jacket and takes her on his bike. Meanwhile, Siddhant hurts his back. Later, Shilpa and Armaan do not hold off their constant bickering much longer and they argue over something. Riddhima comes and Shilpa falls silent. Will Riddhima scold them for their fights?

videos.title: Shilpa Proposes to Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima scolds Shilpa for indiscipline. But Shilpa says things that touch Riddhima's heart and she cries. Later, Shilpa trips and falls into Armaan's arms. They share a moment and Shilpa proposes to Armaan. Will Armaan accept?

videos.title: Shilpa and Riddhima Object Armaan
videos.overview: Shilpa and Riddhima object to Armaan’s idea of operating an obese patient without anaesthesia. Later, he refuses to tie the friendship band to Shilpa. Meanwhile, Siddhanth decides to make Shilpa and Armaan get closer. What will Siddhanth do?

videos.title: Truth or Dare
videos.overview: Armaan, unwilling to bluntly tell Shilpa off, ties a friendship band on her hand. Later, on Shilpa's suggestion, everyone plays Truth or Dare. Shilpa dares Armaan to a blind fight. Siddhant feels happy that the dare is bringing Armaan and Shilpa closer. Is it really?

videos.title: Shilpa and Armaan Get Close
videos.overview: Shilpa and Armaan's blind fight brings both of them physically closer. Riddhima is angry on seeing them so close. Later, Riddhima tells Siddhant that Armaan should find a mature girl and Shilpa is not mature at all. Why is Riddhima interfering? Does she still have feelings for Armaan?

videos.title: Shilpa's Surprising Revelation
videos.overview: Siddhant asks Shilpa to assist Armaan. She behaves in a childish manner and Riddhima gets furious. Armaan asks Shilpa to concentrate on the work and not play the fool. Shilpa reveals something that surprises Armaan. What is it that Shilpa knows?

videos.title: Armaan and Shilpa Get Closer
videos.overview: Siddhant asks Armaan to become the disciplinarian, but Shilpa suggests Riddhima's name. A disagreement between the male and female interns ensues and this leads to an argument. Riddhima blames Shilpa for this. Later, Armaan and Shilpa get physically close.

videos.title: Riddhima Asks Armaan About Shilpa
videos.overview: Riddhima feels something is on between Shilpa and Armaan. Shilpa, lost in thought over what's happening between her and Armaan, doesn't pay attention. Armaan is furious and asks her to concentrate. Later, Riddhima asks Armaan about his feelings for Shilpa. What will Armaan say?

videos.title: Armaan has Another Street Fight
videos.overview: Shilpa feels sad that Armaan doesn't have feelings for her. Later, despite being stopped by Riddhima and Shilpa, Armaan participates in a street fight. However, Riddhima asks him to promise not to raise his hand during the fight. Will Armaan honour the promise and get beaten up in the bargain?

videos.title: Armaan is Saved
videos.overview: Armaan is beaten up by his opponent but refuses to fight back. Riddhima and Shilpa plead for the fight to be stopped, but to no avail. Finally, someone interferes and saves Armaan. Who was it that saves Armaan? Who will Armaan blame for his condition?

videos.title: Riddhima Cries
videos.overview: Siddhant sees Riddhima holding a picture and crying. Shilpa is upset knowing that Armaan isn't interested in her and that he was in a relationship with Riddhima. Later, Siddhant asks Shilpa to help Armaan become more responsible. How will Shilpa help? Whose picture was Riddhima holding and crying?

videos.title: Armaan's Rude Behaviour
videos.overview: Siddhant notices Armaan's rude behaviour with everyone, especially Shilpa. Siddhant asks Armaan to control his behaviour. Despite being upset, Shilpa cares about Armaan. Siddhant tells Armaan that his behaviour is affecting Siddhant's and Riddhima's marriage. Will Armaan relent or take advantage?

videos.title: Armaan Apologises to Shilpa
videos.overview: Siddhant feels guilty about his behaviour and apologises to Shilpa. Now that she knows about Armaan and Riddhima's past, Shilpa decides not to think about Armaan anymore. Siddhant express his insecurities about Armaan to Riddhima. Has Shilpa truly moved on? What will Armaan do next?

videos.title: Armaan's New Date
videos.overview: Armaan wants everyone to move on and so he plans to lie to Siddhant and Riddhima about being in love with some girl. Meanwhile, Siddhant gets upset as Riddhima keeps thinking about Armaan. Later, at a party, Armaan brings a date with him. How will Shilpa and Riddhima react?

videos.title: Shilpa and Armaan Dance Together
videos.overview: Armaan wants Siddhanth and Riddhima to feel that there is something between him and Shilpa. Meanwhile, Siddhanth asks Armaan to visit the Panchgani orphanage. Later, in a dance competition, Shilpa and Armaan dance. In the meantime, Riddhima avoids Siddhanth at home. Does Armaan like Shilpa’s company?

videos.title: Siddhant Irritated With Riddhima
videos.overview: The management asks Armaan and Shilpa to go on an assignment together. Riddhima gets upset with this and asks Siddhant to prevent it, but he refuses. Siddhant gets irritated with Riddhima's interest in Armaan's life. Will Riddhima sense Siddhant's irritation? Where are Armaan and Shilpa being sent?

videos.title: Shilpa Goes to Her Orphanage
videos.overview: Shilpa accompanies Armaan to the orphanage she grew up in. Armaan and Shilpa conduct medical training for the children in the orphanage. Meanwhile, Shashank meets Siddhant and Riddhima and asks them about their relationship. They both assert that they are happy. Will Shashank sense something amiss?

videos.title: Armaan has Feelings For Shilpa
videos.overview: Armaan and Shilpa get stuck in a fire and Armaan saves her. In the process, he realises he has feelings for Shilpa. Meanwhile, Riddhima and Siddhant decide to remarry. Siddhant invites Shilpa to the remarriage while Riddhima invites Armaan.

videos.title: Sid and Riddhima to Remarry
videos.overview: Riddhima and Siddhant's plans to remarry upsets Armaan. Riddhima discusses her marriage with Shashank. Riddhima informs Siddhant that she will have to stay at her maternal home until they get married. Siddhant's friends plan a small surprise bachelor's party for him.

videos.title: Sid's Bachelor Party
videos.overview: Shilpa sees Riddhima's name written in blood and gets worried. Armaan asks Shilpa to attend Riddhima and Siddhant's wedding. At the bachelor party, Munni dances with the interns and chases Siddhant. Riddhima is shocked to see Munni with Siddhant.

videos.title: Shilpa Comes Without Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima tells Siddhant that she appreciates his honesty. Jignesh and Yuvraj play a prank on Jitendra. Meanwhile, Siddhant gets busy preparing for, and arranging, the wedding. Both Siddhant and Riddhima appear to be happy. Siddhant sees Shilpa and asks about Armaan. What does she say?

videos.title: Banquet Booking Cancelled
videos.overview: Shilpa hesitates to mention Armaan in front of Riddhima. Meanwhile, Siddhant and Riddhima are happy to see Anjali. Shilpa tells Siddhant that Armaan has disappeared. While Siddhant is wondering if he should tell Riddhima about this, he is told that the banquet booking has been cancelled. Who cancelled it?

videos.title: Ominous Happenings
videos.overview: Siddhant unknowingly wears a torn outfit and also wipes his face with a cloth used to wipe spilled polish. Later, Jitendra spoils Riddhima's mehendi by spilling juice on her hand. Siddhant wonders why such things are happening and if these are signs of something bad.

videos.title: Riddhima Finds Out About Armaan
videos.overview: Siddhant wants to tell Riddhima about Armaan, but Shilpa stops him. Jignesh, Yuvraj and Jitendra don't find a wedding hall, so Shilpa suggests the terrace as a venue. Later, Siddhant tells Riddhima that Armaan will not be attending their marriage as he has disappeared. How will Riddhima react?

videos.title: Riddhima and Sid Get Married
videos.overview: Despite Armaan's absence, Riddhima and Siddhant get married. Siddhant is nervous about their first night. The interns give him moral support. Later, Siddhant messes up his room because of a cockroach. Riddhima is frustrated and goes to sleep. An upset Armaan plans something. What is it?

videos.title: Sid and Riddhima Go On Honeymoon
videos.overview: Siddhant and Riddhima go to a resort for their honeymoon. Coincidentally, Jignesh, Yuvraj, Jitendra, Shilpa and Anjali also come to the same resort. When everyone come face to face, an argument ensues. Meanwhile, Armaan plans to meet Riddhima. How will Siddhant react?

videos.title: Armaan Watches Riddhima
videos.overview: Riddhima feels nervous as she senses the presence of Armaan. Armaan come to the resort and secretly watches Riddhima. While the girls and boys challenge each other to a game of Rugby, Armaan wonders if Riddhima can love anyone else. Can she?

videos.title: Riddhima Thinks About Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima feels sad and upset about petty things. She finds herself in Siddhant’s arms but thinks he is Armaan. Riddhima remembers Armaan repeatedly, but forces herself to accept Siddhant as her husband. Can she truly do so? Will she be able to forget Armaan completely?

videos.title: Riddhima Hugs Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima intends to hug Siddhant, but unknowingly hugs Armaan. He tells her that she is everything to him and that he still loves her. Riddhima feels guilty about this and tells Siddhant the truth. Will Siddhant appreciate Riddhima's honesty or will he misunderstand her?

videos.title: Armaan In Riddhima's Mind
videos.overview: Riddhima is shattered by what has happened. She imagines Armaan sitting on her bed, asking her to tell Siddhant that she truly loves Armaan. Siddhant notices how upset Riddhima is and tries to comfort her. Will Riddhima appreciate Siddhant's gestures or reciprocate Armaan's love?

videos.title: Sid Tries to Get Romantic
videos.overview: When Armaan confronts Riddhima and forces her to speak the truth, she avoids the subject. Siddhant is shocked to see Riddhima in such trauma. Riddhima finds it hard to forget Armaan. Armaan asks Riddhima to reveal everything to Siddhant. Siddhant tries to get romantic with Riddhima. Will she give in?

videos.title: Sid Seeks Armaan's Help
videos.overview: Unaware of what Armaan has told Riddhima, Siddhant seeks Armaan's help to know what's wrong with Riddhima. Later, Armaan asks Riddhima to tell Siddhant that she still loves Armaan. Riddhima tells Armaan that she doesn't love him. Will Armaan believe Riddhima and leave her alone?

videos.title: Sid Blames Himself
videos.overview: Still unaware of the reason for Riddhima's internal turmoil, Siddhant feels he is responsible for Riddhima being upset. Riddhima remembers Armaan's words and feels depressed. Meanwhile, Siddhant anxiously tries to find out what's bothering Riddhima. Will he find out?

videos.title: Shilpa’s House Party
videos.overview: Shilpa asks Armaan to assist in co-ordinating a party. Later, everybody makes up their mind to attend the party at Shilpa’s house. Meanwhile, Shilpa has a fight with Armaan. Later, Riddhima is uneasy when she spots Armaan. Does Shilpa really like Armaan?

videos.title: Organising Shilpa’s Party
videos.overview: The episode begins with Armaan and the rest assisting Shilpa prepare for the party. Later, Shilpa’s mother justifies the relevance of friendship. Meanwhile, Riddhima feels awkward to be with Armaan, who later tells her something. What does Armaan tell her?

videos.title: Armaan Escapes Being Spotted
videos.overview: Armaan and Riddhima meet. All of a sudden, Siddhant walks in. Riddhima gets scared, but Armaan escapes before being spotted. Siddhant implores Armaan to help him figure out what's wrong with Riddhima. Armaan tells Siddhant to listen to his heart.

videos.title: Armaan Hurts Himself
videos.overview: Armaan feels jealous to see Siddhant and Riddhima together. In a fit of rage, he hurts himself and his hand starts bleeding. Later, Riddhima confesses to Armaan that she still cares for him but is concerned about Siddhant. She asks for day to take a decision. What will Riddhima decide?

videos.title: Armaan Awaits Riddhima's Decision
videos.overview: Riddhima prays for guidance in taking the right decision. Armaan waits anxiously for the next day, while Siddhant wonders where Riddhima is. They both start searching for Riddhima. Eventually, they find her. What does she tell Siddhant?

videos.title: Sid and Armaan Fight
videos.overview: Siddhant yells at Armaan and asks him to stay out of his and Riddhima's personal matter. He accuses Riddhima of betraying him. Siddhant blames Armaan and tells him that he has taken advantage of Riddhima. This leads to a fight between Armaan and Siddhant. What will be the outcome?

videos.title: Shilpa Tries to Convince Sid
videos.overview: Shilpa tries to convince Siddhant that Riddhima cares for him. Armaan comes to Siddhant's house and asks about Riddhima. Siddhant tells Armaan that Riddhima is with her friend. Meanwhile, Riddhima decides to start a new life. What will happen to each of them?

videos.title: Riddhima Stops Siddhanth
videos.overview: Riddhima opposes Siddhanth from assigning Armaan’s duty since Sanjeevani’s management has assigned her for the job. Later, Armaan confesses his love to Riddhima. Meanwhile, Siddhanth confesses his love for her. What will Riddhima do?

videos.title: Armaan Decorates Riddhima's Cabin
videos.overview: Shilpa finds Riddhima's cabin beautifully decorated and thinks it's Siddhant's doing. She later finds out that it was actually done by Armaan. Shilpa is heartbroken. Riddhima and Armaan see each other, but hesitate to speak. How long will they be able to hold back their feelings?

videos.title: Shilpa Decides to Quit Sanjeevani
videos.overview: Shilpa tells Siddhant that she is leaving and he comforts her. But when Shilpa tells Riddhima about her departure, she asks Shilpa to stay back. When the news reaches Armaan he tries to stop her as well. Will Shilpa listen to Armaan?

videos.title: Danger At Sanjeevani
videos.overview: Armaan regrets how he had behaved with Shilpa in the past. Later, an electric problem in Sanjeevani puts everyone's lives at risk. Riddhima, Armaan and Siddhant keeps their differences aside and try to save lives. The three of them have a revelation.

videos.title: Sid Saves Armaan
videos.overview: Riddhima and Siddhant panic as Armaan risks his life to save theirs. When Armaan's life gets endangered, Siddhant saves him. The three of them survive the ordeal. Riddhima and Armaan have an emotionally charged conversation. What do they discuss?

videos.title: Riddhima's Decision
videos.overview: Riddhima tells Armaan that she has chosen Siddhant to do her duty as a wife and not as a lover. Siddhant overhears this and is disheartened. Siddhant thinks over Riddhima and Armaan. Riddhima and Armaan also ponder about their feelings. Will an upset Siddhant do anything drastic?

videos.title: Sid Divorces Riddhima
videos.overview: Siddhant shocks Riddhima by saying that he knows that she loves Armaan and so he wants to end their marriage. He advises her to get married to Armaan. He signs the divorce paper. Siddhant meets Armaan and tells him to marry Riddhima. How does Riddhima react?

videos.title: Riddhima Writes to Armaan
videos.overview: Siddhant asks Armaan to propose to Riddhima. Armaan gets a letter from Riddhima and feels disheartened. Siddhhant consoles Armaan and advises him not to lose hope. Later, Siddhant decides to leave Sanjivani and stay away from Riddhima. What was written in the letter?

videos.title: Armaan Finds Riddhima In Delhi
videos.overview: Armaan goes to Delhi in search of Riddhima. Dr. Shubhankar is surprised to see Armaan. Armaan seeks Dr. Shubhankar's help and finds Anjali's house, as he figures that Riddhima is with her. At Anjali's house, Riddhima is shocked to see Armaan. Will she agree to meet him?

videos.title: Armaan Enters Dr. Kirti's House
videos.overview: Riddhima tells Anjali that she wants to stay away from Armaan and Armaan overhears this. Later, Armaan tries to convince Anjali that he wants Riddhima back in his life. Later, Armaan hears that Riddhima is in Dr. Kirti's house and tries to secretly enter the house. Will he get caught?

videos.title: Riddhima Joins Sanjivani
videos.overview: Armaan tries to convince Riddhima, but in vain. While Riddhima agrees to join Sanjivani, she tells Armaan to stay away from her. Later, Dr. Kirti joins Sanjivani and instructs Armaan to maintain discipline in the hospital. Where has Siddhant gone?

videos.title: Shubankar Tries to Assist Armaan
videos.overview: Shubankar tries to assist Armaan to get back his love. Later, Riddhima misinterprets a patient since she is thinking about Armaan. Meanwhile, Shubankar and the others ask for Armaan’s help. What help do they want?

videos.title: Shubhankar Flirts With Kirti
videos.overview: Shubhankar has feelings for Kirti and Armaan agrees to help him. Shubhankar flirts with Kirti, but she shows anger and scolds him. Later, Armaan decorates the hospital to help Shubhankar's cause. Will Kirti reciprocate Shubhankar's feelings?

videos.title: Riddhima Plans to Quit Sanjivani
videos.overview: Anjali lies to Riddhima that Armaan plans to get married. Riddhima becomes upset when she hears this. Meanwhile, Shubhankar organizes an event with the intention of making Riddhima jealous. Riddhima does, and decides it's best that she quit Sanjivani to stay away from Armaan.

videos.title: Armaan Tries to Convince Riddhima
videos.overview: Shubhankar lies to Riddhima that he has chosen a girl for Armaan. Riddhima, who is already upset, makes a decision to quit Sanjivani at the earliest. When Armaan hears this, he gets worried and tries to convince Riddhima. Will Riddhima stay back?

videos.title: Armaan is Sarcastic to Riddhima
videos.overview: Anjali, Shubhankar and the interns, plan to get Riddhima and Armaan together. Later, Armaan and Riddhima cross paths and Armaan treats her in a sarcastic and scornful manner. Meanwhile, Shubhankar and Kirti have an argument. Will Armaan and Riddhima's altercations bring out their love?

videos.title: The Basketball Match
videos.overview: Kirti and Shubhankar provoke Riddhima and Armaan into playing a basketball match. With the goal being bringing Armaan and Riddhima closer, Kirti instructs everyone to pretend to play a serious game. During the match, Armaan and Riddhima bump into each other several times. Will Kirti's plan work?

videos.title: Riddhima Gets a Phone Call
videos.overview: Riddhima gets a phone call, but postpones it to the next day. The boys lose the Basketball match and Kirti hints that Armaan's love for Riddhima was the reason. Everyone plan a farewell party for Riddhima. Riddhima wishes to be Armaan's date. Will he ask her out?

videos.title: Shubankar Charms Kirti
videos.overview: Shubankar charms Kirti to be his date for the prom. Meanwhile, Riddhima informs Armaan that she will be assisting him in the surgery. Further, she informs him that she is leaving for Harvard the next day. Later at the prom, Kirti waits for Armaan and Riddhima.

videos.title: Riddhima Loves Armaan
videos.overview: When Shashank tells Armaan that Riddhima loves him, he wants to prevent her from going. Meanwhile, Riddhima goes around Sanjeevani bidding farewell to her colleagues and friends. Later, Riddhima approaches Armaan. Will Riddhima leave for Harvard?
